hf.title: Has GPT-6-Astra Achieved Embodied Intelligence?
hf.abstract: GPT-6-Astra demonstrates a level of competence in robotic manipulation and navigation that challenges the conventional paradigm of building specialized models for individual tasks and embodiments. In this report, we ask not only how capable GPT-6-Astra is, but what its capabilities imply for the field. First, we probe the limits of standalone GPT-6-Astra. We conduct a large-scale evaluation across 12 representative benchmarks spanning tabletop manipulation, humanoids, mobile platforms, and dexterous hands. Under a unified protocol that allows in-context learning (ICL) from training-set demonstrations and substantially increases the number of execution steps, GPT-6-Astra achieves unprecedented performance (Fig. 1). Future research may focus on improving 1) the generality of ICL 2) cost and execution time, 3) physical-state verification, 4) recovery from irreversible failures, and 5) long-horizon preservation of progress. Second, we study the agentic harness for embodied control. We identify that close-loop coordination between a high-level "System 2" reasoner (i.e., GPT-6-Astra) and a low-level "System 1" controller (e.g., π0.5) is costly but effective. Third, we examine GPT-6-Astra on real-world deployment. Our experiments on 8 robot configurations reveal substantial gaps: 1) robot demonstrations required for ICL are expensive to collect, and 2) it is implausible to trade longer execution for higher success rates with physical constraints. Fourth, we envision the next generation of embodied benchmarks. We develop a prototype that 1) derives tasks from real-world needs, 2) provides no in-domain demonstrations, and 3) judges agents on a world clock that keeps running while they deliberate. Taken together, our results suggest that GPT-6-Astra has largely crossed the threshold of embodied competence, but not yet that of practical embodied intelligence.
hf.titleZh: GPT-6-Astra 是否已实现具身智能?
hf.summaryZh: 在覆盖桌面操作、人形机器人、移动平台与灵巧手的12个基准上，以统一协议(允许从训练集演示做上下文学习并大幅增加执行步数)评测GPT-6-Astra的独立能力。进一步研究具身控制的agentic harness，发现高层「System 2」推理器与低层「System 1」控制器(如π0.5)的闭环协同代价高但有效。8种真实机器人配置上的部署实验暴露明显差距:ICL所需演示采集昂贵，且物理约束下难以用更长执行时间换取成功率。论文还给出下一代具身基准原型(任务取自真实需求、不提供域内演示、以持续运行的世界时钟评判)，结论是模型已跨过具身能力门槛，但尚未达到实用具身智能。
hf.reason: 具身智能与机器人操作评测，属画像明确低分方向

hf.title: BizBench: Unveiling Hidden Challenges in Deploying Long-Horizon Agents for Real-World Business
hf.abstract: Existing long-horizon agent benchmarks often emphasize final task success while providing limited assessment of intermediate execution validity. Yet real-world business operations require agents to navigate extensive, potentially outdated or conflicting policies while satisfying critical constraints throughout execution. These requirements are particularly consequential in high-stakes domains such as payments, where intermediate violations can incur financial losses or regulatory consequences regardless of the final outcome. To bridge this evaluation gap, we introduce BizBench, a multi-turn benchmark grounded in real-world procedures from a leading payments company. Its executable environment integrates 789 knowledge documents and 601 discoverable business tools, with consistent policies, states, and tool behavior. The benchmark comprises 50 tasks involving resource constraints, temporal dependencies, prior commitments, and conflicting or outdated guidance. Each task is validated through reference execution, while deterministic checks assess both goal attainment and execution validity without prescribing a single solution path. Experiments reveal substantial limitations even among frontier models: Claude Opus 5 and GPT-6 Sol achieve strict success rates of only 64.0% and 61.3%, respectively. For Qwen3.8-27B, goal attainment reaches 42.0%, but strict success drops to 32.7%, demonstrating how outcome-based evaluation can mask invalid execution. Beyond success rates, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash averages 191.3 tool calls per run, approximately 70% more than reference executions, revealing substantial execution overhead. Overall, BizBench establishes a testbed for evaluating and advancing long-horizon agents beyond task completion, toward reliable and constraint-compliant execution in complex business environments.
hf.titleZh: BizBench：揭示长程 Agent 在真实商业场景部署中的隐藏挑战
hf.summaryZh: 长程 Agent 评测普遍偏重最终任务成功率，忽视中间执行是否合法。BizBench 以真实支付业务为基础构建多轮基准：可执行环境包含 789 篇知识文档与 601 个可发现工具，50 个任务覆盖资源约束、时间依赖、既有承诺以及冲突或过期政策，并用确定性检查同时判定目标达成与执行合法性。前沿模型的严格成功率也只有 64.0%（Claude Opus 5）和 61.3%（GPT-6 Sol）；Qwen3.8-27B 目标达成率为 42.0%，但严格成功率降至 32.7%；DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 平均每次运行发起 191.3 次工具调用，比参考执行多约 70%。
hf.reason: 长程 Agent 评测基准，环境与约束设计扎实，直击工具调用可靠性

hf.title: LEV: Thinking Fast and Deep with Looped Decision Models
hf.abstract: Decision models answer typed questions about an input with one probability per option, computed in a single forward pass without generating text. Like the fast System 1 of dual-process theory, they answer at once, but their depth is fixed at training time, so they spend the same computation on easy and hard questions. Models that reason in generated text can think longer, but they pay for every extra step in decoded tokens. We present LEV, a decision model that thinks deeper by rerunning its layers in a loop instead of generating tokens. LEV builds on a language model pretrained as a loop, reads the options after every loop step and trains all steps jointly, so one checkpoint can answer at any depth. On three looped backbones, accuracy rises with depth on the same weights, mostly on hard questions, and a 2.6B LEV goes from 63.2% at depth one to 76.2% at depth four on JevBench. On-demand depth, set per question by a small stopper with a threshold fitted on unlabelled requests, saves 15% to 24% of the computation at a cost of under one accuracy point, level with or slightly above a fixed mix of depths. On a locked test set, the 1.4B and 3B models are 5.4 to 8.8 points more accurate than dense (non-looped) models and cascades of the same latency below 50 ms.
hf.titleZh: LEV:用循环决策模型又快又深地思考
hf.summaryZh: 决策模型单次前向即可为每个选项给出概率，但深度在训练时就固定，简单题与难题花费相同计算。LEV 让以循环方式预训练的语言模型通过反复复用层来「想得更深」，每个循环步后读取选项并联合训练所有步，使单一 checkpoint 可在任意深度作答;在三个循环骨干上准确率随深度上升且主要集中在难题，2.6B 模型在 JevBench 上从深度1的63.2%升至深度4的76.2%。再用小型 stopper 按问题设定阈值实现按需深度，节省15%–24%计算而准确率损失不足1个点;在锁定测试集上，1.4B与3B模型在低于50ms延迟下比同延迟的稠密模型与级联高5.4–8.8个点。
hf.reason: 循环深度与自适应计算，命中LLM架构与推理效率方向

hf.title: HexaShell: A Thin Harness for Exploring the Limits of VLM Agents as Robot Coding Agents
hf.abstract: Agents built on vision language models (VLMs) now compete with learned policies on robot manipulation leaderboards. We ask how far a coding agent can go when it controls a robot instead of a computer, and where it stops. Our system, HexaShell, keeps the harness thin: it only turns the agent's commands into robot motion. The agent drives a robot with two arms through one command line. It sees three RGB cameras and knows their calibration. After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools. In this way it keeps what it learns as code, as a coding agent does when it fixes a failing test. The tools may use only what the robot observes. They use triangulation to find where objects are, relative to each other and to the gripper. If two cameras see the same point, the point lies where the two camera rays meet. If a point lies on a known plane, such as the table or the top of a block, it lies where its ray meets that plane. When the head camera is not enough, the robot moves a wrist camera to get a second view. We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed. We use Codex with GPT-6-Astra at medium reasoning effort. On all 42 RoboDojo tasks, HexaShell reaches a success rate of 39.7% and a progress score of 48.0, averaged in the same way as the leaderboard. This is a new state of the art on RoboDojo. The limit is contact, not reasoning: pushing reaches 92.5% and memory tasks 65.0%, but tight insertion only 8.3%. When the agent fails, it usually sees the failure but cannot make the motion work. We open source the tools evolved so far at https://github.com/HexaFuture/HexaShell.
hf.titleZh: HexaShell:一个轻量harness，用于探索VLM Agent作为机器人编码Agent的能力边界
hf.summaryZh: 考察编码Agent操控机器人时能走多远、又卡在哪里。HexaShell的harness极薄，只把命令行指令转成双臂机器人动作;Agent依靠三路RGB相机与已知标定，用三角测量和平面求交定位物体，失败后读日志、定位原因并把修复沉淀为可复用的代码工具，必要时移动腕部相机取第二视角。工具仅在每个任务单seed的十种布局上演化后冻结，再在同seed的十个新布局上测试。Codex+GPT-6-Astra在RoboDojo全部42个任务上达39.7%成功率、48.0进度分，刷新榜单;推挤92.5%、记忆任务65.0%，紧配合插入仅8.3%，瓶颈在接触控制而非推理。
hf.reason: 机器人操作属低分方向，仅薄harness与代码工具演化略沾Agent边

hf.title: PremiseCheck: Efficient Fact-Checking of Human and AI Peer Reviews
hf.abstract: Peer review is under strain from the growth of submissions, and review comments written by humans or AI can misstate what a paper says. We introduce ReviewFact, a benchmark that labels such factual errors in review comments under one definition across NLP, machine learning, and the natural sciences, and that measures cost and latency alongside accuracy. A frontier LLM checks comments well but must read the whole paper for each check, while cheap decision models, which score whether a statement holds in a text, fall far short on whole comments that mix several implicit assertions. PremiseCheck is a framework that combines the two. An LLM rewrites each comment as explicit premises without reading the paper, and a decision model checks each premise against the paper. When each comment is checked on its own, PremiseCheck reaches accuracy comparable to GPT-5.5 across all three fields at about half its cost, and on NLP reviews at a quarter of its cost and less than half its latency.
hf.titleZh: PremiseCheck：对人工与 AI 同行评审的高效事实核查
hf.summaryZh: 同行评审中人类或 AI 撰写的评论常误述论文内容，前沿 LLM 虽能核查但每条都需通读全文，成本与延迟高；廉价判定模型面向整条混合多个隐含断言的评论时准确率远不足。工作提出 ReviewFact 基准，在 NLP、机器学习与自然科学上以统一定义标注评论中的事实错误，并同时测量成本与延迟；PremiseCheck 让 LLM 在不读论文的情况下把评论改写为显式前提，再由判定模型逐条对照论文核验。逐条核查时准确率与 GPT-5.5 相当而成本约减半，在 NLP 评审上成本降至四分之一、延迟不到一半，为评审质量把关提供了可负担的级联方案。
hf.reason: 评审事实核查基准＋级联核查框架，属评测方法学扎实工作

hf.title: Learning to Think and Explore in 3D World
hf.abstract: We study how vision-language models (VLMs) can learn to think and actively explore in 3D space. Instead of providing multi-view images, videos, or 3D representations to the model, we preserve the native visual encoding of VLMs, i.e., a single image, one at a time, just like humans, and treat the 3D representation only as an environment with which the model can interact through actions (e.g., move left) and observations (rendered images). Each rollout begins from an initial first-person view and a visual question. The model can then iteratively reason, navigate, and reorient its viewpoint before committing to a final answer. Following an initial trajectory-supervised finetuning, we apply reinforcement learning (RL) with rewards driven primarily by final-answer correctness. Crucially, RL provides no direct supervision over which viewpoints the model should visit or which exploration actions it should take. Instead, the model must learn an effective exploration policy solely from the extent to which its interactions improve performance. Across six 3D benchmarks, our model ACT3D achieves an average accuracy of 53.2% that improves its base Qwen model by 22.0% and surpasses proprietary Gemini 3.6 Flash. ACT3D also outperforms existing open-source 3D methods while using 50-70% fewer input frames, and generalizes to unseen domains with an average improvement of 5.9% over its supervised initialization. Further analysis reveals adaptive, question-conditioned exploration. Performance gains over the base model increase from 0.6% on questions answerable from the initial view to 16.3% on those requiring extensive exploration. ACT3D searches for occluded targets, avoids unnecessary exploration, and acquires complementary viewpoints for spatial comparisons. These findings demonstrate that outcome-based RL enables VLMs not only to reason over visual evidence, but also to learn when and how to acquire it.
hf.titleZh: 在3D世界中学习思考与探索
hf.summaryZh: 让VLM像人一样一次只看一张第一人称图像，把3D场景仅当作可交互环境，通过移动、转向等动作迭代推理并主动获取新视角后再作答。方法上先用轨迹监督微调，再用仅以最终答案正确率为奖励的强化学习训练探索策略，不对访问哪些视角或采取何种动作施加直接监督。在六个3D基准上平均准确率达53.2%，较基座Qwen提升22.0%，超过Gemini 3.6 Flash，并在输入帧数减少50-70%的情况下优于开源3D方法;相对监督初始化在未见域上平均再提升5.9%。分析显示模型学会了按问题自适应探索:初始视角即可回答的问题增益仅0.6%，而需大量探索的问题增益达16.3%。这一结果说明基于结果的RL可让VLM不仅推理视觉证据，还学会何时以及如何获取证据，适用于需要主动感知的多模态Agent。
hf.reason: 结果驱动RL让VLM自主学习3D探索策略，兼跨多模态与Agentic RL

hf.title: Into the Unknown: Benchmarking AI agents on open scientific research problems
hf.abstract: Can AI agents carry out research on open scientific problems? We introduce Into the Unknown, a benchmark that provides an agent with a science paper along with a research direction to pursue and tasks it to write a follow-up paper. We work with scientists at US Department of Energy (DOE) national laboratories, who each contribute an unpublished follow-up direction from their own work together with the necessary conditions a submission must meet. While assessing the quality of a follow-up paper is challenging in general, using these conditions to form a rubric makes evaluation more tractable for research problems that have no reference answer. We have nine frontier agents write 15 follow-ups each, spanning quantum computing, plasma physics, computational chemistry, materials science, and scientific machine learning domains. None of the 135 submissions satisfies all the conditions, and 114 fail our integrity check, most often because the paper claims work that was never done or reports numbers that contradict the recorded evidence. Overall, agents readily produce papers that look like follow-ups, but none meets the standard of the domain scientist, leaving substantial headroom. Our code and data are publicly available.
hf.titleZh: Into the Unknown：面向开放科学研究问题的 AI agent 基准
hf.summaryZh: 构建 Into the Unknown 基准：给定一篇科学论文与一条尚未发表的研究方向，要求 agent 写出后续论文；由美国能源部国家实验室的科学家为各自方向设定投稿须满足的条件，并据此形成评分 rubric，使没有参考答案的开放问题变得可评估。九个前沿 agent 在量子计算、等离子体物理、计算化学、材料科学与科学机器学习领域共提交 135 篇后续论文，无一满足全部条件，114 篇未通过完整性检查，多因声称未做的工作或数据与记录证据矛盾。agent 能产出形似后续论文的文本，但离领域科学家的标准仍有明显差距。
hf.reason: Agent 科研基准，rubric 与完整性检查设计扎实

hf.title: LiveMACE: Process-Aware Evaluation of LLM Agent Capabilities in Evolving Markets
hf.abstract: Evaluating agents by outcomes alone can obscure the capabilities that produce them. This problem is especially pronounced in evolving environments, where outcomes reflect a closed-loop interaction between agent behavior and changing external conditions. We introduce LiveMACEBench, a process-aware benchmark that uses live financial markets as a naturally evolving testbed for persistent LLM agents. Five frontier LLMs operate along continuous trajectories under matched Tool Use, Persistent Memory, Rule Following, and Multi-Agent Collaboration configurations. We evaluate them through both realized outcomes and mechanism-specific diagnostics derived from complete decision traces. Across 30 days of live evaluation, we find a pronounced outcome-capability gap: realized returns often diverge from capability-specific measurements, and similar outcomes can arise from markedly different patterns of mechanism use. Trace-level diagnostics further expose distinct bottlenecks across capabilities, demonstrating that mechanism access, effective mechanism use, and downstream performance are not interchangeable measures of agent capability. LiveMACEBench makes this distinction measurable, turning live markets from a performance leaderboard into a diagnostic environment for agent capability
hf.titleZh: LiveMACE：演化市场中 LLM Agent 能力的流程感知评测
hf.summaryZh: 只用结果来评测agent会掩盖能力本身的来源，在环境持续演化时尤为突出。为此构建LiveMACEBench，以真实金融市场作为自然演化的测试床，让五个前沿LLM在工具调用、持久记忆、规则遵循与多智能体协作四种配置下沿连续轨迹运行，并同时用最终收益和由完整决策轨迹导出的机制级诊断指标来评测。30天在线评测显示明显的结果—能力落差：实现收益常与能力测量不一致，相似结果可能来自截然不同的机制使用模式，机制可及性、有效使用与下游表现三者并不等价。
hf.reason: Agent流程感知评测基准，命中Agent与评测方法学方向

hf.title: Pack Light, CarryOn: Building Object-Oriented Context for Long-Horizon Agents
hf.abstract: Long-horizon agents accumulate progress in persistent task state, yet repeatedly process interaction histories describing how that progress was achieved. This raises a natural question: can long-horizon context instead be organized around reusable progress rather than the history that produced it? In this paper, we introduce CarryOn, an object-oriented context runtime that organizes continuation around reusable task objects. Rather than treating compressed histories or reconstructed accounts of progress as the primary basis for continuation, CarryOn builds a context view from continuation carriers, complementary execution context, and a live tail of recent interactions. A core challenge is keeping this reusable basis valid after its surrounding history is retired: how can CarryOn update the basis without reconstructing the full representation at every fold? CarryOn maintains carrier records across folds, revising affected records against bound evidence and applicable environment checks while carrying forward unaffected records and jointly updating execution context. Experiments on OSWorld 2.0 and BrowseComp-Plus show improved gains of 5.8% and 7.0% while reducing total token usage by 51.9% and 22.9%, respectively. Project page: https://ethannju.github.io/carryon
hf.titleZh: 轻装前行：为长程Agent构建面向对象的上下文
hf.summaryZh: 长程Agent的任务状态虽被持久保存，却仍需反复处理描述进展如何取得的交互历史，上下文随步数膨胀。CarryOn把上下文组织为面向对象的运行时：以可复用的任务对象（continuation carriers）、补充执行上下文与近期交互尾段构建上下文视图；在折叠历史后跨折叠维护carrier记录，仅依据绑定证据与环境校验修订受影响的记录，并沿用未受影响的记录、联合更新执行上下文，避免每次重建完整表示。在OSWorld 2.0与BrowseComp-Plus上分别取得5.8%与7.0%的提升，同时总token用量下降51.9%与22.9%。该工作为长程Agent的上下文压缩与记忆管理提供了可增量维护的工程路径。
hf.reason: 长程Agent上下文与记忆管理，方法新颖且实验扎实

hf.title: Speculative Sampling in Interactive Video Generation
hf.abstract: Interactive video generation commonly relies on small bidirectional chunks to reduce response latency. Yet our preliminary experiments show that larger chunks improve video quality and better utilize GPU parallelism, allowing more latents to be sampled with only a modest increase in sampling time. Motivated by these observations, we propose Speculative Sampling, a strategy that combines the modeling power of large bidirectional windows with the low-latency interaction of small ones. It expands the modeling window by appending noise latents as padding and caches the resulting predictions for reuse when the condition remains unchanged. Predictions are delivered incrementally, while the uncommitted future remains replaceable. Our latency analysis shows that this removes the waiting-time lower bound imposed by chunk boundaries, shifting the optimization focus from reducing chunk size to accelerating per-chunk sampling. Bidirectional window size thus becomes a decision variable for jointly optimizing visual quality and sampling time, rather than a necessary constraint on low-latency interaction. This opens a path to serving large bidirectional models in interactive streaming systems without complex streaming post-training.
hf.titleZh: 交互式视频生成中的投机采样
hf.summaryZh: 交互式视频生成通常依赖小的双向分块以降低响应延迟，但实验发现更大分块能提升视频质量并更好利用 GPU 并行，采样时间仅小幅增加。为此提出 Speculative Sampling 策略：通过追加噪声 latent 作为 padding 扩展建模窗口，并缓存条件不变时的预测结果供复用，预测增量交付且未提交的未来仍可替换。延迟分析表明该方法消除了分块边界带来的等待时间下界，使双向窗口大小成为联合优化视觉质量与采样时间的决策变量，而非低延迟交互的必要约束，为无需复杂流式后训练即可在交互式流式系统中服务大型双向模型提供了路径。
hf.reason: 视频生成加速，属低分方向，仅采样复用机制沾边

hf.title: MOSS-Image Technical Report
hf.abstract: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.
hf.titleZh: MOSS-Image 技术报告
hf.summaryZh: 面向开放权重文生图模型在密集文字与复杂版式上明显落后于闭源系统的问题，构建了从零预训练的 5B 单流扩散 Transformer(DiT)，支持中英双语长文本渲染与精确版面控制，并配套一个意图感知的 Agent 式提示增强模块，把用户请求转写为细化的内容与版式规格。同时提出 LongLongTextBench(LLTB)评估中英文长文本渲染、RealLayoutArena(RLA)评估端到端富版式生成。在 LLTB 上开放权重模型中达到 SOTA，平均文字覆盖率为 96.3%;在 RLA 端到端系统对比中位列第二，其主干在使用统一增强提示的生成器对比中排名第一。模型、训练配方与评测框架将开源。

hf.title: Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation
hf.abstract: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong design intelligence: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce Scene-Designer, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. We construct two datasets: Scene-OTA-35K, which provides Observation--Thought--Action supervision for learning scene design and efficient error correction, and Scene-OTC-15K, which provides Observation--Thought--Critic supervision for learning scene quality critique across physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence. Based on these experiences, we propose Scene-GRPO, a Critic-guided GRPO framework that improves design decisions and reduces unnecessary trial-and-error corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique. Moreover, test-time Critic guidance further improves scene generation, showing that the Critic can provide useful guidance beyond training. Additional analysis suggests a trend of mutual enhancement between scene design and critique abilities.
hf.titleZh: Scene-Designer:为智能体式3D场景生成学习设计智能

hf.title: Lexical Reference Frames: Interpreting LM Residual Streams in Native Semantics
hf.abstract: The vocabulary of a language model is its native semantics: the embedding and the unembedding fix the meaning of a state at the two ends of the residual stream. Between them, existing methods either reuse a fixed lens or treat the states as a point cloud, and neither reads a state the way the model does. We argue that every hidden state has a native reference frame, induced by the layers that read it next and adaptive to the context. Lexical reference frames approximate it by reading a state through the model's own remaining layers with a stated number of rounds of attention between positions and a typical attention output for the rest, without fitting to the model's output. No lens, with fixed directions per layer, can exceed the square root of the native frame's coherence, 0.30 and 0.35 at mid-depth of SmolLM3-3B and OLMo3-7B, whereas the first-order frame, LexFrame[1], reaches 0.97 and 0.97 and reads a state within 0.16 nats of the model's output. Its coefficients attribute predictions more faithfully than attribution patching, its lexical basis steers a prediction while sparing other tokens, and its confident readings would let an early exit skip 0.45 and 0.42 of the layers, where lenses skip almost none. In this way, lexical reference frames make every hidden state of the model readable, attributable and steerable.
hf.titleZh: 词汇参考系:以原生语义解读语言模型残差流

hf.title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
hf.abstract: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

hf.title: From Research Goals to Scientific Closure: Evaluating Agents Through Evidence-Supported Physics Research
hf.abstract: Can AI agents organize scientific investigations that lead to well-supported conclusions? To evaluate this capability, we introduce PhysClosureBench, a benchmark of 50 expert-verified, goal-specified research tasks spanning strong-field, attosecond, and neighboring physics areas. Each task specifies the research objective and essential scientific constraints, while leaving the agent to organize the investigation and determine how to generate and validate the evidence needed to answer the question. A 20-criterion Atomic Score measures local scientific accomplishment, while Research Closure (RC0--RC4) assesses how fully the investigation resolves the specified research question based on whether its indispensable evidence requirements and applicable scope conditions are satisfied. We evaluate seven frontier LLMs, where Claude-Opus-5 achieves the highest mean Atomic Score (6.29/10) but reaches RC4 in only 32.7% of attempts. Across the benchmark, 36.2% of attempts scoring at least 8/10 still fall short of RC4, while all seven models reach RC4 on substantially fewer tasks in all three runs than in at least one. Case-level analysis further illustrates how misinterpretation of generated results and unresolved physical applicability limits can lead to incomplete closure. Together, these results reveal a persistent gap between AI agents' local scientific accomplishments and their ability to achieve complete research closure.
hf.titleZh: 从研究目标到科学闭环：以证据支撑的物理研究评估 Agent
hf.summaryZh: 评估 AI Agent 能否组织出证据充分、结论可靠的完整科学调查，需要可量化的闭环标准。PhysClosureBench 覆盖强场、阿秒等物理方向的 50 个经专家校验、给定目标的研究任务；每个任务只给出研究目标与关键科学约束，由 Agent 自行组织调查、生成并验证证据。评测采用 20 项 Atomic Score 衡量局部科学成果，并用 Research Closure（RC0–RC4）依据必要证据条件与适用范围是否满足，判定问题被解决的程度。七个前沿 LLM 中 Claude-Opus-5 平均 Atomic Score 最高（6.29/10），但仅 32.7% 的尝试达到 RC4；且 36.2% 得分不低于 8/10 的尝试仍未达 RC4，说明局部成果与完整研究闭环之间存在持续差距。

hf.title: BridgeWAM: Bridging Video and Action Experts via Latent Bridge Queries
hf.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) commonly couple video and action experts through dense, layer-wise Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) attention, exposing action prediction to irrelevant visual features while enforcing matched expert depths. This coupling hinders selective visual-feature use and introduces redundant computation. We introduce Bridge-of-Experts (BoE), instantiated as BridgeWAM, which aggregates visual, language, and proprioceptive priors through 32 Latent Bridge Queries (LBQs) into a shared, limited latent space. Joint video-action supervision lets action gradients guide the Video Expert toward representations better suited for action prediction, while the Action Expert learns to selectively retrieve task-relevant information through cross-attention. Decoupling expert depths and reusing LBQs during action denoising yield a 5.06B model with a 30-layer Video Expert and a two-layer Action Expert, achieving 98.25% success on LIBERO and 72.24% pooled success on LIBERO-Plus, demonstrating effective task execution and strong generalization with an ultralight action head. Ablations support joint representation adaptation and unified LBQ conditioning. Relative to Fast-WAM, BridgeWAM reduces single-sample inference FLOPs by 28.72% in simulation profiling and real-robot latency to 77.1 ms (a 2.47-fold speedup). Qualitative experimental results further indicate preferential attention to target objects and task destinations across perturbations.
hf.titleZh: BridgeWAM：用潜在桥接查询打通视频与动作专家

hf.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become a scalable post-training paradigm for large language models. However, training agents over long-horizon interactions presents two challenges: using only terminal rewards makes turn-level credit assignment sparse and high-variance, while sequential mini-batch updates on a fixed rollout batch introduce policy staleness as the current policy drifts from the behavior policy. Existing approaches obtain denser credit via learned critics, process reward models, or on-policy distillation, but they rely on a value network, step-level annotations, or a stronger external teacher that increase training complexity. Meanwhile, importance sampling and clipping mitigate policy drift, but they do not specify a finite target that stops sequential updates from overshooting. In this work, we introduce TreeOPSD, a critic-free, tree-aware posterior self-distillation framework for long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning. Treating each interaction turn as a tree node, TreeOPSD branches alternative continuations from shared prefixes and recursively backs up terminal rewards into implicit turn-level credit. It then maps each credit to a closed-form, bounded teacher distribution parameterized by the likelihood ratio relative to the frozen behavior policy. Minimizing the divergence between this teacher and the student policy recovers the policy-gradient direction as the tangent at the behavior policy while bounding updates toward a finite target across sequential mini-batches. Empirically, TreeOPSD improves agentic capabilities across several competitive benchmarks and model scales, especially for long-horizon tasks, e.g., raising the average accuracy of Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 by 4.97 points over GRPO on the Deep Research setting.
hf.titleZh: 面向长程 Agentic RL 的树感知后验蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 长程 Agentic RL 中，只用终端奖励导致轮次级信用分配稀疏、高方差，而在固定 rollout 批次上做序列小批量更新又会因策略漂移产生策略陈旧问题。TreeOPSD 将每个交互轮视为树节点，从共享前缀分叉出多条续写路径，把终端奖励递归回传为隐式轮次级信用，再将其映射为由相对冻结行为策略的似然比参数化的闭式有界教师分布;最小化该教师与学生策略的散度，既在行为策略处切向恢复策略梯度方向，又把序列更新约束到有限目标。在多个 Agentic benchmark 与模型规模上取得提升，长程任务尤为明显，如在 Deep Research 设定下将 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking-2507 的平均准确率较 GRPO 提升 4.97 分。

hf.title: Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report
hf.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. Specifically, a lightweight decoder combines vision-encoder patch features with visual latents, the language model's mask-token states, so mask supervision reaches the shared backbone without an additional segmentation encoder. Because each latent decodes to a mask, the model can interleave reasoning with region-specific latents and thus think with visual latents, while grounded reasoning traces supervise the regions it visits during chain-of-thought. As a result, across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits, Xiaomi-Lens-0 gains 5.6 points on average over Qwen3.5 in referring comprehension and achieves the highest segmentation cIoU among compared models. Moreover, it surpasses Qwen3.5 across all perception benchmarks. Homepage: https://seerray-lab.github.io/Xiaomi-Lens-0{this https URL}

hf.title: RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars
hf.abstract: Making a conference poster is visual coding in miniature: an entire paper must be compressed onto a single page, which exercises summarization, visual design, and code implementation at once, using nothing beyond the paper itself. Yet benchmarks for this task in the context of visual coding remain scarce: existing resources are small and annotated only with layout boxes, so evaluation must fall back on VLM-as-judge or human checklists rather than objective render-and-compare, and the generation methods they support design layouts from scratch, leaving human-crafted posters unusable as either a retrievable design library or as verified supervision. We introduce RAP (Reconstruct A Poster), a dataset and benchmark for paper-to-poster generation as a visual coding task. RAP contains 25K+ verified paper-poster pairs from various machine learning conferences held between 2022 and 2026, annotated with a three-level content taxonomy, plus a held-out benchmark of 150 test papers each paired with its human poster. A fully automated derendering pipeline turns each poster into styled HTML/CSS of typed, refillable slots, so every sample is a paper-poster-markup triplet verifiable by rendering against the source poster. The corpus serves both inference and training: PosterRAG, a training-free multi-agent pipeline, retrieves an exemplar and refills its slots without touching layout or styling, while an SFT+RL recipe trains a dedicated model from the same triplets. An online demo is available at https://reconstruct-a-poster.github.io/.
hf.titleZh: RAP：一个从人工海报样例出发、基于声明式标记的论文转海报生成数据集

hf.title: Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models
hf.abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.
hf.titleZh: 先执行后记忆：诊断视频世界模型中的记忆失效
hf.summaryZh: 针对视频世界模型的记忆评测，指出现有测试把「场景是否建立」「指定变更是否执行」「末帧是否呈现结果」合并为单一分数，导致执行失败容易被误读为遗忘；而变更未执行时隐状态转移根本不会发生，评测本身就不成立。MIST 把变更与它应留下的记忆分开：模型先在变更隐藏的情况下建立场景，之后才被要求呈现该变更，并控制此前泄漏。该分离将瓶颈定位为「场景已建立，但未执行指定变更」，且这一缺口在通用记忆评测中同样存在。据此提出 M3-Agent，递归改写输入指令细节，使冻结模型完成指定动作；MIST reveal 分数提升三倍以上，WRBench 的 T 提升 26.1%，MBench-T 的 U 提升 52.7%。

hf.title: Can Visual Generation Expand What Unified Multimodal Models Know?
hf.abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) receive image-generation supervision that exposes them to visual information not fully documented in text. Can learning to generate images expand what pretrained models know? We introduce Knowledge Transfer Probing (KTP), a controlled protocol that supplies new knowledge through image-generation training and tests its accessibility through text-only question answering. Across seven knowledge categories and three UMMs, we observe direct but uneven transfer from visual supervision to language. Motivated by these observations, we successively introduce Textual Alignment and Interleaved Image--Text Alignment, which connect generation and answering through shared knowledge and interleaved responses, respectively. Guidance on selected entities can improve knowledge access on other entities without QA supervision, with additional gains from interleaved alignment. Further analysis shows that knowledge correctly reproduced in images is often more accessible through text, although substantial gaps remain between the two forms of access. These findings support visual generation as a source of knowledge beyond textual supervision, and motivate joint investigation of training data design and model architecture to make this knowledge more broadly accessible.
hf.titleZh: 视觉生成能否扩展统一多模态模型所知？

hf.title: MTEdit: Packed Trajectories Beat Rollouts for Multi-Turn Image Editing
hf.abstract: Multi-turn image editing aims to modify an image according to a sequence of instructions, making it better aligned with human-AI collaborative creation than single-turn editing. However, constructing high-quality multi-turn training data remains challenging, as conventional sequential rollout accumulates errors and introduces visual-quality drift across editing turns. To address this challenge, we introduce MTEdit, a multi-turn image editing dataset built through a pipeline centered on packed trajectory canvas (PTC) generation. By jointly generating multiple editing states within a unified visual context, this pipeline reduces visual-quality drift across turns. Covering both step-wise and context-aware editing scenarios, MTEdit comprises 500K multi-turn image editing trajectories, with up to 8 turns and an average of 5.38 turns per trajectory, making it one of the most extensive datasets for multi-turn image editing. We further introduce MTEdit-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate both scenarios by assessing models' ability to follow editing instructions, maintain content consistency, resist visual-quality drift, and effectively use historical context across turns. Using MTEdit, we fine-tune Qwen-Image-Edit-Causal to obtain Qwen-Image-MTEdit. On MTEdit-Bench, we evaluate a broad range of closed-source and open-source image editing models, including Qwen-Image-MTEdit. Experimental results show that Qwen-Image-MTEdit achieves the best performance among the evaluated open-source models, demonstrating the effectiveness of MTEdit in improving models' multi-turn image editing capabilities.
hf.titleZh: MTEdit:打包轨迹优于 rollout，用于多轮图像编辑
hf.summaryZh: 多轮图像编辑按指令序列逐步修改图像，但顺序 rollout 会累积误差并导致跨轮视觉质量漂移，高质量多轮训练数据难以构建。MTEdit 以打包轨迹画布(packed trajectory canvas,PTC)生成为核心:在统一视觉上下文中联合生成多个编辑状态，从而抑制跨轮质量漂移。数据集覆盖逐步编辑与上下文感知两类场景，含 50 万条轨迹，最长 8 轮、平均 5.38 轮;配套 MTEdit-Bench 从指令遵循、内容一致性、抗质量漂移和历史上下文利用四个维度评测。基于该数据微调的 Qwen-Image-MTEdit 在所评开源模型中取得最佳成绩。
hf.reason: 多轮图像编辑数据与基准，属视觉生成方向，不在关注范围

hf.title: DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI
hf.abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.
hf.titleZh: DLite：面向 Agentic AI 的无历史投机解码
hf.summaryZh: 在 agentic 负载下，上下文长且持续演化，draft 模型的接受长度最多下降 80%，而保留历史 KV cache 又会带来显著系统开销;DLite 把不断增长的历史上下文视为这两个问题的共同根源，直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态做局部投机预测，不再显式维护历史上下文，并用轻量顺序头以低开销恢复块内因果依赖，配合定制的两阶段训练策略适配这一异构架构。在通用、长上下文与 agentic 负载上，DLite 取得 2–6 的接受长度，相比 SOTA 方法 DSpark 最高提升 70%。该工作为 Agent 场景下的推理加速提供了不依赖历史状态的投机解码方案。
hf.reason: 投机解码针对 Agent 长上下文退化，系统效率方向扎实

hf.title: OmniXRef: A Unified Framework for Multimodal Multi-Reference Video Editing
hf.abstract: Creative intent in video editing can be expressed through text instructions (e.g., "remove the people"), image references (e.g., subject appearance), video references (e.g., camera movement), or a combination of the above. We introduce OmniXRef, a unified framework for multimodal multi-reference video editing that allows users to combine variable numbers of text, image, and video references to control diverse attributes of a source video. We first devise a unified input design with a reference-bank interface and introduce R^2-RoPE to support generalization to more references. Then our model, OmniXRef-Model, uses a single-stream diffusion transformer to jointly process the source video and multimodal context from an MLLM in an interleaved sequence. To address the scarcity of training data for video-reference editing, we construct OmniXRef-Data using synthesis pipelines for different editing tasks and combinations of references. We use curriculum learning to progressively increase task complexity and resolution. To support systematic evaluation of video as a control modality, we introduce OmniXRef-Bench, a benchmark for video-reference attribute transfer across Camera, Motion, Content, Style, and Visual Effects (VFX). Comprehensive evaluations show that our OmniXRef-Model outperforms task-specific baselines and commercial models.
hf.titleZh: OmniXRef：面向多模态多参考视频编辑的统一框架
hf.summaryZh: 视频编辑中的创作意图可由文本指令、图像参考、视频参考或它们的组合来表达，而现有方法通常只能处理单一条件。OmniXRef 统一了可变数量的文本、图像与视频参考：设计带参考库接口的统一输入形式，并提出 R^2-RoPE 以泛化到更多参考；模型采用单流扩散 Transformer，在交错序列中联合处理源视频与来自 MLLM 的多模态上下文。针对视频参考编辑训练数据稀缺，构建了覆盖不同任务与参考组合的合成数据管线 OmniXRef-Data，并以课程学习逐步提升任务复杂度与分辨率；同时发布 OmniXRef-Bench，评测 Camera、Motion、Content、Style、VFX 五类视频参考属性迁移，结果显示其优于任务专用基线与商业模型。
hf.reason: 扩散式视频编辑生成，落在低分方向

hf.title: OfficeTown: Generative Organizations for Evolving Agent Intelligence
hf.abstract: AI agents increasingly use files and software tools to produce professional deliverables. Such work draws on materials, decisions, and feedback accumulated across assignments. We introduce OfficeTown, a generative simulation framework for professional organizations in which tasks and their context arise from continuing organizational work. From a natural-language description of an organization's purpose and activities, OfficeTown initializes an organization whose members coordinate work, delegate bounded assignments to assistant agents, and review their deliverables. Artifacts, decisions, and unresolved matters persist and shape subsequent work, while responsibilities and permissions determine what each member can see and do. We curate work requests, their context, and review feedback into executable resources for evaluation and learning. We construct OfficeTown Bench with 406 tasks and 4,836 evaluation criteria from 23 simulated organizations across eight professional domains, incorporating domain-expert feedback. Frontier-model evaluations reveal substantial remaining headroom. Supervised fine-tuning and on-policy distillation on OfficeTown data substantially improve Qwen3.5-9B on external professional-work benchmarks, including GDPval. Supplementary evaluations show that the principal--assistant harness achieves higher scores than the single- and multi-agent baselines tested. These results highlight the value of organizational simulation in generating work-grounded data and environments for the continued development of generalist agents.
hf.titleZh: OfficeTown:面向持续演化的智能体智能的生成式组织
hf.summaryZh: 专业工作类 Agent 缺少来自持续组织运转、而非人工一次性构造的任务与上下文。OfficeTown 从一段组织目标与活动的自然语言描述出发，初始化出可协作的模拟组织:成员分派边界明确的子任务给 assistant agent 并评审交付物，产物、决策与未决事项持久留存并影响后续工作，职责与权限决定各成员的可见范围与可操作范围;工作请求、上下文与评审反馈被整理为可执行资源，用于评测与训练。据此构建的 OfficeTown Bench 覆盖 8 个专业领域的 23 个模拟组织、406 个任务与 4836 条评估标准;前沿模型评测显示仍有较大提升空间，基于该数据的有监督微调与 on-policy distillation 显著提升 Qwen3.5-9B 在 GDPval 等外部职业工作基准上的表现，且 principal–assistant harness 优于所测单智能体与多智能体基线。
hf.reason: 组织级 Agent 环境与任务合成，兼含 on-policy distillation，命中 Agent 方向

hf.title: DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses
hf.abstract: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.
hf.titleZh: DiscoveryRSI:递归学习以发现有价值的假设
hf.summaryZh: 科学发现需要对有价值的假设做持续开发，而从这一演化式研究过程中学习仍很困难。DiscoveryRSI 用多智能体进化搜索构建假设树，将选中的调研编译为可执行的 Harbor 任务，并通过假设信用优化、harness 回放、再发现三种机制递归积累经验;同时提出 DFM-Bench，在假设、修订、发展路径与研究轮次四个层面评估假设质量与累积进展。在四个生命科学领域，假设质量从基座模型的 4.86 升至两轮自我改进后的 5.39，可证伪性与数据可解析性提升最大;专家评审中 DiscoveryRSI-27B 在假设重要性与证据约束性上优于 GPT-6 Luna，其假设与模型截止后发表研究的对应率为 6.3%，高于 GPT-6 的 2.5% 与 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%。工作为科研智能体的自我改进循环与假设级评测提供了可复用的框架。
hf.reason: 科研智能体加递归自我改进，系统完整并配假设级 benchmark，直击 AI for Research

hf.title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
hf.abstract: Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256times256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.
hf.titleZh: 一致性分布匹配:无数据扩散蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 扩散与流模型因数值积分步数多而推理缓慢，现有蒸馏方法依赖人工整理的蒸馏数据集、昂贵的教师轨迹采样或辅助代理网络，训练与扩展成本较高。该方法把采样生成与分数估计统一到同一个学生网络中，整个框架只包含一个冻结教师和一个可训练学生，只优化单一目标，既不需要模拟轨迹也不需要真实数据;作者证明最小化该目标可使学生 flow-map 前推分布以 Wasserstein 距离收敛到教师边缘分布。在 ImageNet 256×256 上，单步(1-NFE)FID 为 2.04,4-NFE FID 为 1.37，仅训练 40 个 epoch 即超过无数据蒸馏的现有基线。
hf.reason: 扩散蒸馏属低分方向，仅与蒸馏、推理效率略沾边

hf.title: Stuck on Shuffle: On Attribute-Object Binding in Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Retrieval is a fundamental task in multimodal systems: given an image or text query, the goal is to find the most relevant images or texts in a collection, often using a shared embedding space. Reliable retrieval requires these embeddings to capture not only which concepts are present, but also how they are composed. One key compositional challenge is attribute--object binding: encoding which attributes belong to which objects. Existing benchmarks provide a limited view of this capability, typically covering a subset of modality pairings, simple two-object swaps, or small attribute sets. Consequently, it remains unclear how robustly current models preserve attribute--object bindings across different modality pairings and more complex settings. We therefore introduce SABER, a controlled benchmark for evaluating attribute--object binding across all four image and text modality pairings, spanning diverse attribute types and scenes with up to ten objects. Evaluating models on SABER reveals substantial binding failures in both CLIP-style dual encoders and recent MLLM-based embedders. These findings motivate us to ask how binding can be improved efficiently. While multimodal supervision may be effective, collecting suitable images is difficult and costly. Text, on the other hand, is well suited to binding supervision: it is cheap to generate, supports a broader range of attributes and enables precisely controlled hard negatives. We thus finetune an MLLM-based embedder exclusively on synthetic attribute-binding text. Despite the absence of image supervision, the gains transfer to cross-modal and image--image retrieval while preserving general multimodal embedding performance. Our model achieves SOTA results on SABER while also improving on negation and instance-retrieval benchmarks, demonstrating broader benefits of our binding-focused supervision.
hf.titleZh: 卡在打乱上：论视觉语言模型中的属性—对象绑定
hf.summaryZh: 多模态检索依赖嵌入不仅编码概念存在性，还要编码概念的组合方式，其中属性—对象绑定是关键却缺乏系统评测。为此构建 SABER 受控基准，覆盖全部四种图像／文本模态配对、多种属性类型与最多十个对象的场景，评测显示 CLIP 式双塔编码器与基于 MLLM 的嵌入器均出现显著绑定失败。随后仅用合成的属性绑定文本对 MLLM 嵌入器做微调，在无图像监督下收益仍迁移到跨模态与图像—图像检索，并在 SABER 上取得 SOTA，同时提升否定与实例检索基准表现。
hf.reason: 多模态嵌入的属性绑定评测与文本监督微调，命中评测与多模态方向

hf.title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to 0.998 macro-AUROC and 95.6% eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.
hf.titleZh: 信念轨迹能量：度量通往预测的路径
hf.summaryZh: LLM 在 Transformer 各层逐步修正预测，通常却只保留最终输出、丢弃形成预测的中间轨迹。BTE 将各层隐状态映射到共享预测空间，用 Fisher-Rao 几何刻画逐层信念修正，可汇总为标量或深度剖面。标量 BTE 在多种推理任务上提供与具体模型相关的难度信号，结构化表示用于检测人类与 LLM 评审、以及生成器归因，八分类准确率达 95.6%，macro-AUROC 最高 0.998；该信号随预训练形成，并会被针对性训练选择性重塑。
hf.reason: 层间信念轨迹度量，方法新颖且实证强，属分析/评测工具

hf.title: Embeddings Are Overpriced? A Frozen 16 MB Vocabulary for Small and Ternary Language Models
hf.abstract: In a small language model the vocabulary is the single largest part. In Gemma 3 270M the embedding table holds 168M of 268M parameters, and because quantisation methods leave the embedding in 16-bit, it is also most of the file once the rest of the model is compressed. We ask what that table actually buys. We replace it with one frozen table of 512-bit codes, 16 MB, with no trainable parameters, derived once from a pretrained embedding by principal-component projection and sign binarisation, and we train the same Gemma-shaped body from scratch on the same 2.05B tokens with and without it. The learned table buys 0.20 nats of validation loss for 2.6 times the trainable parameters, but on LAMBADA, HellaSwag and PIQA the frozen-table model is better or tied; only ARC-Easy favours the learned table. With a ternary BitNet b1.58 body the whole model is a 46 MB file, still ties the float model on LAMBADA and PIQA, and on a laptop CPU generates 615 to 740 tokens per second in 62 MB of memory, five to six times the speed of the float model's 8-bit GGUF in llama.cpp at a seventh of the memory. The frozen table wins by 1.7 to 2.3 nats on rare words, accepts 10,000 new words after training with a 3% cost where the learned table collapses by 43%, and all of it is released with the weights, the data and every evaluation answer.
hf.titleZh: 嵌入的代价被高估了？面向小型与三值语言模型的 16 MB 冻结词表
hf.summaryZh: 针对小语言模型中词表嵌入占据大部分参数与模型体积的问题，从预训练嵌入经 PCA 投影与符号二值化导出 512 位码的冻结词表（16 MB，无可训练参数），并在相同 2.05B token 上从头训练同构 Gemma 体做对照。学习词表以 2.6 倍可训练参数仅换来 0.20 nats 验证损失改善，而 LAMBADA、HellaSwag、PIQA 上冻结词表持平或更优。搭配 ternary BitNet b1.58 主干后整模型为 46 MB 文件，笔记本 CPU 上达 615–740 tokens/s、占用 62 MB 内存，约为 float 模型 8-bit GGUF 的 5–6 倍速且内存仅七分之一。稀有词上领先 1.7–2.3 nats，训练后新增 1 万词仅付出 3% 代价。
hf.reason: 冻结二值词表配合 ternary 主干，命中高效架构与推理方向

arxiv.title: Text-to-Image Generative Modeling Without Language Pretraining
arxiv.abstract: Modern text-to-image (T2I) systems use internet-scale language pretraining for text-conditioned image generation. We ask whether language pretraining is necessary for strong T2I generation. We introduce Halcyon, a family of early-fusion multimodal autoregressive models pretrained entirely from scratch on GPIC, a dataset of 100M image-text pairs. Halcyon-0.52B outperforms LlamaGen-XL/8 (48.0 vs. 63.3 gFD) with 18.2$\times$ less pretraining compute. Further, Halcyon-1.6B outperforms JiT-T2I-XXL/8++ (35.3 vs. 41.0 gFD) with 275$\times$ less pretraining compute. Controlled experiments show that text-only pretraining does not improve T2I generation. Halcyon also learns image captioning by replacing caption dropout with I2T supervision, maintaining competitive T2I generation quality under the same pretraining budget. We show that strong T2I systems can be trained from scratch without internet-scale language pretraining. Code and models are available at https://cs.stanford.edu/~keshik/halcyon
arxiv.titleZh: 无需语言预训练的文本到图像生成建模
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有文本到图像（T2I）系统普遍依赖互联网规模的语言预训练来获得文本条件能力，本工作追问这一依赖是否必要。作者提出 Halcyon 系列早期融合的多模态自回归模型，完全从零在 1 亿图文对数据集 GPIC 上预训练，并以 gFD 作为生成质量指标。Halcyon-0.52B 以 48.0 对 63.3 的 gFD 优于 LlamaGen-XL/8，预训练算力少 18.2 倍；Halcyon-1.6B 以 35.3 对 41.0 优于 JiT-T2I-XXL/8++，算力少 275 倍。控制实验显示纯文本预训练并不能提升 T2I 生成，且将 caption dropout 换成 I2T 监督即可同时学到图像描述能力。该结果说明高质量 T2I 系统可不依赖大规模语言预训练而从零训练，对多模态早期融合架构与预训练配方设计有参考价值。
arxiv.reason: 早期融合多模态自回归有架构参考价值，但主题属图像生成低分方向

arxiv.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
arxiv.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.
arxiv.titleZh: OpenVLHarness:面向真实世界的多模态智能体工具调用与多模态记忆
arxiv.summaryZh: 在22个基准上的对照实验显示，单纯提高基座模型的推理预算只带来有限提升，许多视觉任务仍需通过异构工具获得有依据的感知、外部知识与数值测量，且工具输出必须可被模型解读并在推理步之间保留。OpenVLHarness 以能力层与持久化多模态记忆为核心:能力层提供任务级工具接口与证据渲染，把异构后端输出转成模型可读的观察;持久记忆将图像、结构化数据与网页引用保存为可按地址访问的工件，代码接口则在已存数据上执行程序以组合多工具结果。在22个基准、八个开源与闭源基座上，平均分较无工具基线提升9.7–12.6分，其中 Qwen3-VL-8B +11.2、Kimi K3 +9.7、GPT-6 Astra +9.9;GPT-6 Luna 中等推理强度下比基座、Codex 与 Visual Sketchpad 的最高强度设置高7.7–8.5分，模型 token 开销至多为其37%。
arxiv.reason: 多模态 Agent harness 与持久记忆，工具调用与证据组合，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
arxiv.abstract: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.
arxiv.comment: 24 pages, 14 figures, 12 tables, including references and appendices
arxiv.titleZh: WeAct:将动态权重切换作为Agent动作
arxiv.summaryZh: 长程Agent需要从交错轨迹中学习异构能力，但共享参数更新会破坏已学能力、造成灾难性遗忘;而联合训练与静态LoRA合并在整个执行过程中都固定同一套参数配置。WeAct在冻结主干上为各能力分别训练独立LoRA适配器，并把适配器选择纳入Agent动作空间，借助模型原生tool-calling接口在同一上下文中按需组合能力。在八个deep-research基准上，Qwen3-32B配合WeAct的平均准确率比全参微调高6.2%(算力更省)，比最强静态LoRA合并方法高27.5%。新增代码计算适配器、更新写作适配器时主干与其他适配器均保持不变，支持Agent的模块化持续适配。
arxiv.reason: 把适配器切换纳入Agent动作空间，命中Agent与后训练方向

arxiv.title: Train An Imaginative Agent
arxiv.abstract: A seemingly reasonable push in Sokoban can make the puzzle unsolvable. To avoid such mistakes, an agent has to anticipate the consequences of its actions before execution, especially when feedback from the real environment is sparse or actions are irreversible. We introduce Agentic Imagination (Agima), a training framework that trains an agent to imagine before acting, i.e. to be imaginative. Agima trains a single omni model to propose actions, generate images of their outcomes, and then reason over these imagined futures to decide what to execute in the real environment. Rather than committing to a single plan, the agent can simulate a sequence of actions, explore alternatives, and compare possible futures. We first use supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to unify policy and world modeling within a single omni model. This enables the agent to predict future outcomes and perform basic forms of imagination, such as forward thinking and counterfactual branching. We then use agentic reinforcement learning (RL) to teach the agent to reason with its imagined futures and use them effectively for planning. Across four environments spanning Maze2D, Sokoban, Pacman, and PushT, Agima generalizes to harder settings unseen during training. Trained with SFT alone on two-box Sokoban, Agima solves 40% of four-box puzzles while seeing the real board only once every five moves, compared with an action-only planner that only solves 2%. After RL, new behaviors emerge in how Agima uses its imagination: it learns a new unified format that was unseen during the SFT stage, learns to conduct forward thinking only when necessary, and branches more frequently at critical decision points. An agent that can picture where its actions lead can learn when and where to look ahead, that is, to plan. Project page: https://agima.net/.
arxiv.titleZh: 训练一个富有想象力的智能体
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对Sokoban等环境中不可逆动作导致失败的问题，提出Agima训练框架:让单个全模态模型先提出动作、生成动作结果的图像，再在想象出的未来上推理以决定实际执行的动作。先用SFT把策略与世界模型统一进同一模型，使其具备前向推演与反事实分支能力;再用智能体RL教会模型利用想象未来进行规划。仅用两箱Sokoban做SFT，在四箱任务且每五步才观测一次真实棋盘的条件下解出率达40%，而仅基于动作的规划器仅2%;RL后还涌现出SFT阶段未见过的统一格式、按需前向推演与关键决策点更频繁分支等行为。该工作把视觉世界模型与Agentic RL结合，为稀疏反馈、不可逆场景下的规划提供了可借鉴范式。
arxiv.reason: 想象式世界模型加Agentic RL做规划，直接命中Agent高分方向

arxiv.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
arxiv.abstract: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.
arxiv.titleZh: AnyGoal:论世界模型在专家轨迹之外的泛化
arxiv.summaryZh: 世界模型的可靠性取决于能否在专家轨迹未覆盖的状态—动作组合上正确预测动力学，而数据覆盖、动力学泛化与下游规划性能之间的关系仍缺乏系统研究。AnyGoal 以组合泛化为切入点，在常用世界模型环境上构造目标偏移任务变体:单个状态因子与动作均落在训练支撑之内，但其组合在专家轨迹中出现稀疏，并配套开源库。在多个环境与世界模型族上的评测显示，现有模型在这类重组下一律失败，并可归因于动力学预测与表征两类误差。该框架为衡量世界模型能否泛化到新规划任务提供了统一基准与诊断视角。
arxiv.reason: 世界模型泛化基准，与Agent环境建模擦边

arxiv.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.
arxiv.titleZh: LatComm：面向大语言模型间潜在通信的可复用上下文压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 多模型系统常把同一段长上下文以文本形式反复传给接收模型，导致每个问题都需重新编码全部token。LatComm将编码与读取分离：冻结的上下文编码器LLM先在无问题条件下把上下文压成固定大小的潜在包，另一个冻结的接收LLM通过由其提示计算门控的交叉注意力按问题选择性读取。在12个多项选择问答数据集上，其平均准确率较单向量基线最高提升10.2分；在QuALITY上把接收端输入减少57倍，并使同一文章的问题回答快3倍。该接口面向可复用、跨模型且紧凑的上下文表示，适用于多LLM协作与长上下文推理场景。
arxiv.reason: 跨模型潜在上下文压缩与高效推理，方法新颖且实验扎实

arxiv.title: Same Simulation, Different Evidence: Where Retrieved Tool Output Costs LLM Agents Accuracy
arxiv.abstract: LLM agents that compute the right answer can still answer wrongly. Agent harnesses increasingly keep long tool outputs out of the context window, saving them to files that the agent searches or reads on demand. We ask where this costs accuracy with a real scientific tool: PHREEQC, a widely used geochemistry simulator from the USGS, whose reports reach 846.8k characters and whose determinism lets every printed value be traced. Agents use it to answer 158 execution-verified multiple-choice items. When agents read the simulator's report through a section index rather than in context, GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2 lose 11.3 and 7.9 points of accuracy, while Claude Opus 4.6 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 show no detectable cost. Re-running all 11,007 logged simulator calls shows that both GPT models compute the keyed value about as often as before; what changes is the evidence they answer from. Under retrieval they often skip the report, answer from their own higher-precision output files, and misround to a neighboring option, a failure we call evidence substitution. With the simulation held fixed, retrieval still costs GPT-5.2 9.4 points. For GPT-5.4, more frequent correct simulations mask an evidence-use loss of about ten points, leaving a net change indistinguishable from zero. Naming the authoritative output raises accuracy by 6.3-7.9 points over plain retrieval for the three GPT models; for GPT-5.1 and GPT-5.2, inlining outputs that fit works as well, while asking for correct rounding does not. Context-management choices in agent harnesses should be judged by where accuracy is lost, not only by final accuracy.
arxiv.titleZh: 同样的模拟，不同的证据:检索式工具输出在哪里损害LLM Agent的准确率
arxiv.summaryZh: 把冗长工具输出存成文件、按需检索，是Agent常见的上下文管理做法;本研究用确定性地球化学模拟器PHREEQC(报告长846.8k字符)在158道执行可验证的选择题上定位其代价:经章节索引读取报告时，GPT-5.1与GPT-5.2分别掉11.3与7.9分，Claude Opus/Sonnet 4.6无可测损失。重跑11,007次模拟调用显示，两个GPT模型算出关键值的频率几乎不变，变的是它们据以作答的证据——常跳过报告、改用自身更高精度的输出文件并误舍入到邻近选项，称为证据替换。点名权威输出可回升6.3–7.9分，内联放得下的输出同样有效，要求正确舍入则无效。harness的上下文管理应按准确率在哪流失来评估，而非只看最终分数。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness上下文管理与失败归因分析，直击Agent工程实践

arxiv.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
arxiv.abstract: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.
arxiv.titleZh: Kronecker Delta 规则用于长上下文线性注意力
arxiv.summaryZh: 提出 KronLSTM：在线性注意力中用 Kronecker Delta 规则更新关联矩阵记忆，只沿矩阵空间单一方向修正目标关联，从而降低对已存信息的干扰，避免额外的归一化与稳定化机制；理论分析表明其记忆动态为收敛到稳态分布的马尔可夫链，记忆矩阵期望范数全程一致有界。在长上下文基准上，KronLSTM 与 DeltaNet 系列（含 Gated DeltaNet）相当或更优。该工作为递归线性注意力的稳定关联记忆提供了可解析的基础。
arxiv.reason: 线性注意力新记忆更新规则，理论扎实，长上下文表现强

arxiv.title: Competing Learning in Hybrid Architectures
arxiv.abstract: Many modern language models have adopted hybrid architectures that incorporate both linear-time recurrence and softmax attention. Modern recurrence layers provide a highly expressive mixing mechanism while ensuring high throughput by compressing contextual information into a fixed-size state, but underperform softmax attention in contextual information retrieval. In this paper, we reveal a Competing Learning phenomenon where different kinds of mixers compete to learn the same function, and when any layer learns a function, it suppresses the corresponding learning signal for other layers. Layer attribution analysis reveals that under typical data distributions, modern recurrence learns retrieval functions faster than softmax attention, causing attention to fail to learn retrieval in most cases. Stopping weight updates in recurrence in the middle of training helps attention learn retrieval. Based on these results, we propose a staged training procedure for pre-training hybrid architectures on natural language. Empirical results on models up to 1B parameters show that our method results in substantial improvement in language modeling loss, common-sense reasoning, as well as a wide range of retrieval-related tasks across different context lengths.
arxiv.titleZh: 混合架构中的竞争性学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 混合架构同时使用线性时间的递归层与 softmax 注意力，前者吞吐高但对上下文检索能力弱。论文揭示「竞争性学习」现象:不同 mixer 会竞争学习同一函数，任一层学会后就会抑制其他层对应的学习信号;层归因分析显示，现代递归层在典型数据分布下比注意力更快学会检索函数，导致注意力层在多数情况下学不会检索。训练中途冻结递归层的权重更新可让注意力层习得检索能力，据此提出面向自然语言预训练的分阶段训练流程;在最大 1B 参数模型上，语言建模损失、常识推理及多种上下文长度下的检索任务均显著改善。
arxiv.reason: 混合架构预训练机制分析与分阶段训练方法，命中架构与预训练方向

arxiv.title: ProteinGeoBench: Frontier Structural-Biology Agents Are Fluent at Lookup but Lost in Geometry
arxiv.abstract: Frontier agents retrieve structural metadata well and compute geometry from coordinates less reliably. We ask how much of a benchmark score reflects that gap and how much reflects the evaluation configuration around the model. We study ProteinGeoBench, a suite of 131 protein-structure tasks, using 4,249 rollouts from four frontier models and 4,486 further trials across 26 models. Three of the four frontier models fall within 0.031 of one another (0.785 to 0.816) with no difference between them resolved, while the fourth scores 0.707 and all three gaps to it exclude zero. Three of the four do better on metadata lookup than on numeric calculation. The fourth is slightly better on numeric. Numeric tasks are 28 of the 131 but half of the twelve tasks that all four models fail. The ranking also depends on the evaluation budget: with one run per task, 23.9% of bootstrap replicates put a different model first. On a selected 15-task slice, removing network access lowers scores more than blocking eight structural-database domains, but the two contrasts were graded in different passes and cannot be cleanly decomposed. Swapping in each model's own command-line agent changes scores by -0.071 to +0.086, a comparison too small to rule out moderate harness effects. Across 26 models, numeric performance rises with non-numeric performance rather than staying flat. The experiments use different task subsets, so they cannot rank model, harness, access and task composition against one another. Evaluations should report results by task family, along with the number of runs, the harness and the access conditions.
arxiv.comment: 24 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Benchmark and tasks: https://github.com/Protege-AI/ProteinGeoBench
arxiv.titleZh: ProteinGeoBench：前沿结构生物学 Agent 擅长查表，却在几何上迷失
arxiv.summaryZh: 构建含 131 项蛋白质结构任务的基准 ProteinGeoBench，基于四个前沿模型 4,249 条 rollout 与 26 个模型 4,486 次试验，分析基准分数在多大程度上反映模型能力、又在多大程度上反映评测配置。三个前沿模型分数集中在 0.785–0.816 且相互无法区分，第四个为 0.707；多数模型在元数据检索上强于数值几何计算，28 个数值任务却占四个模型共同失败任务的一半。评测预算同样影响排名：每任务仅跑一次时，23.9% 的 bootstrap 重采样会把另一个模型排到第一；换成各模型自带的命令行 harness 后，分数变动在 −0.071 至 +0.086 之间。据此建议按任务族报告结果，并披露运行次数、harness 与网络访问条件。
arxiv.reason: Agent 评测方法论有参考价值，但领域偏结构生物学，属擦边

arxiv.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
arxiv.abstract: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.
arxiv.titleZh: 野外 Agent 世界模型:计算机使用 Agent 的环境合成
arxiv.summaryZh: 在真实计算机系统中扩展交互式学习成本高且存在安全风险，为此提出可扩展流水线 WildAWM，合成同时支持图形界面、MCP 服务与命令行的可执行环境，使 Agent 能组合视觉交互、工具调用与代码执行，且全流程仅用开源模型生成。针对任务合成的可解性、难度与验证器可靠性三个难点，引入基于执行的质量门，结合异构 Agent rollout、交叉裁判一致性检查与反事实探针。最终产出 341 个长程环境-任务对，部分需 100 步以上，GPT-6-Astra 仅解出 60%。仅在这些合成世界中训练的两个 Qwen 模型，在覆盖 web、CLI 与 computer-use 的 8 个分布外基准上均取得显著提升，说明合成环境中的学习可泛化到未见过的计算机使用任务。
arxiv.reason: Agent 环境与任务合成直接命中关注方向，系统性强

arxiv.title: KEEP-Bench: Evaluating Evidence Preservation in Context Compression
arxiv.abstract: Context compression improves long-context efficiency but may introduce faithfulness issues through an information bottleneck. Existing evaluations rely on QA metrics, but a reader can still answer correctly from an unfaithful compression, so these metrics underestimate such loss. To bridge this gap, we introduce KEEP-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that directly assesses compression faithfulness with 4,102 cases across three challenging settings that require keeping evidence for plausible reference resolutions, explicit qualifiers, and minority perspectives. Experiments show that even with tailored prompting, the strongest models remain unreliable: despite context windows exceeding 100K tokens and inputs averaging only 3.1K tokens, the best open-weight model (31B) preserves all required evidence in only 66.8% of cases, and the best proprietary model in only 61.6%. Performance also varies sharply across evidence structures, so conclusions from limited structures may be biased. We further introduce a metric, Evidence Preservation Return (EPR), to relate evidence recall to inference FLOPs, and find that it peaks at moderate scales (4B-8B), where recall remains low. Additional output budget mainly benefits already strong models and widens capability gaps, yet the stronger preservation of these models comes at a steep computational cost. These findings highlight the importance for future work to investigate compressors with strong information preservation under a small computation budget, rather than relying on a large output budget or model scaling.
arxiv.titleZh: KEEP-Bench：评估上下文压缩中的证据保留
