arxiv.summaryZh: 现有上下文压缩评测依赖 QA 指标，但读者可能从丢失关键证据的压缩结果中蒙对答案，从而低估忠实性损失。KEEP-Bench 构造 4102 个诊断样本，覆盖三类必须保留证据的困难设定：对合理指代有多个可行解释、显式限定语、少数派观点，直接考察压缩是否保住关键证据。实验显示，即使针对任务专门提示，最强的开源模型（31B）也仅在 66.8% 的样本中完整保留所需证据，最强闭源模型只有 61.6%，而这些输入平均仅 3.1K token，远低于 100K 的上下文窗口。作者进一步提出 EPR 指标，把证据召回与推理 FLOPs 关联，发现最优性价比落在 4B–8B 规模，但召回仍偏低；增加输出预算主要惠及强模型并拉大能力差距，表明未来应研究小算力预算下的高保真压缩器。
arxiv.reason: 长上下文压缩忠实性的诊断式评测，选题清晰、数据扎实

arxiv.title: RefCraft: Benchmarking Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation through Web Development
arxiv.abstract: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.
arxiv.titleZh: RefCraft：以 Web 开发为场景、评测视觉参考条件化 Agent 生成的基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有网页开发基准多为理想化设定：或只做视觉目标重建，或仅凭文本指令生成页面，缺少「从视觉示例出发开发」这一常见工作流。RefCraft 构建 300 个真实多模态网页开发任务，每条由自然语言指令与 1 至 5 张参考网页截图组成，Agent 需选择性解读参考、渲染输出、视觉检查并迭代修改；评估结合可独立验证的 keypoints 与程序化判分、VLM 判分。九个前沿 (M)LLM 中最佳系统总分仅 52.12/100，说明视觉参考条件化的 Agent 生成在真实网页开发场景下仍是明显短板，可作为该方向的数据与评测基础设施。
arxiv.reason: Agent 网页开发多模态基准，属评测方向扎实工作但非方法创新

arxiv.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
arxiv.abstract: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately $1.86\times$ end-to-end inference speedup and a $66\times$ reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
arxiv.titleZh: MemT-1.0:迈向记忆原生演化
arxiv.summaryZh: 把记忆做成基础模型的内在能力，而非外挂检索模块:MemT-1.0 在 Metis 基础上采用 Gated DeltaNet-2 与稳定的 token 级记忆更新机制，并用 Mixture-of-Storage 扩展原生记忆容量。以 34B token 数据经继续预训练与后训练两阶段流程训练，发布 Nano 与 Flash 两个规模。评测中其参数化记忆平均优于基线、与检索增强方法相当且基本保留通用能力;128K 历史长度下 Nano 端到端推理提速约 1.86 倍，持久化存储较全上下文 KV cache 降低 66 倍;内化检索到的程序性经验还可提升 agent 任务成功率。
arxiv.reason: 记忆原生的新架构与完整训练管线，命中架构与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: SpecMRL: Redesign Matryoshka Representation Learning within Parametric Spectrum
arxiv.abstract: Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL) is designed to support flexible representation sizes by jointly optimizing nested prefixes. While effective, this design lacks an explicit constraint to ensure that the leading portion provides a suitable compact encoding. To address this, we propose SpecMRL, which reorganizes the feature space to enable more effective prefix readout. Specifically, we extend MRL with a parameter-derived spectral basis organized with feature importance. SpecMRL otherwise follows standard MRL, with prefix readout performed in the learned spectral space. Experiments on MTEB show that SpecMRL outperforms MRL at all evaluated reduced dimensions, with larger gains under more aggressive compression. These results suggest that the learned spectral basis better prioritizes informative directions, enabling more effective representation compression. Notably, SpecMRL extends the performance frontier of MRL, surpassing full-dimensional MRL with only half the embedding dimensions.
arxiv.titleZh: SpecMRL：在参数化谱空间内重新设计 Matryoshka 表示学习
arxiv.summaryZh: Matryoshka 表示学习通过联合优化嵌套前缀来支持可变长度的表示，但缺少显式约束来保证前缀部分本身就是合适的紧凑编码。SpecMRL 在 MRL 基础上引入由参数导出、并按特征重要性组织的谱基，把表示的前缀读取改到学习到的谱空间中进行，其余流程与标准 MRL 一致。在 MTEB 上的实验显示，SpecMRL 在所有评测的降维设置下都优于 MRL，压缩越激进提升越明显；仅用一半嵌入维度即可超过全维度的 MRL。该工作为嵌入压缩与检索场景中的表示学习提供了一种更有效的参数化组织方式。
arxiv.reason: 嵌入表示压缩的增量改进，与后训练/Agent 主线关联有限

arxiv.title: AfriBED: a Speech Recognition Bias Evaluation Dataset for Low Resource African Languages
arxiv.abstract: Despite advancements in automatic speech recognition systems (ASR), current systems exhibit speaker-attribute bias, i.e., their speech recognition performance is biased against certain speakers based on their demographic attributes such as gender, accents, and speaker type. However, accurately assessing speaker attribute bias in a given ASR system requires the availability of a bias evaluation dataset with comparable speech across subgroups of a speaker attribute. In this paper, we introduce African speech Bias Evaluation Dataset (AfriBED), a novel speech recognition bias evaluation dataset for two low resource African languages, Bemba and Nyanja, to detect and estimate gender and speaker-type bias for ASR systems. The dataset comprises 9 hours of speech with 3928 utterances recorded by 80 speakers for Bemba, while the Nyanja set includes 6260 utterances with approximately 18 hours of speech recorded by 127 speakers. The results of our baseline experiments demonstrate that the datasets are useful for examining gender and speaker-type attribute bias in the target languages.
arxiv.comment: accepted at 2026 IEEE Spoken language Technology Workshop Demo Track
arxiv.titleZh: AfriBED：面向低资源非洲语言的语音识别偏见评测数据集
arxiv.summaryZh: 语音识别系统存在说话人属性偏见，即识别性能会因性别、口音、说话人类型等人口学属性而系统性偏斜，但评估这类偏见需要子群体间语音内容可比的评测集。为此构建了 AfriBED，覆盖 Bemba 与 Nyanja 两种低资源非洲语言：Bemba 部分含 80 位说话人的 3928 条语音、约 9 小时；Nyanja 部分含 127 位说话人的 6260 条语音、约 18 小时。基线实验显示该数据可用于检测和估计性别与说话人类型偏见，为低资源语言的 ASR 公平性评测提供数据基础。
arxiv.reason: 低资源非洲语言 ASR 偏见评测集，属语音应用方向，与关注方向几乎无交集

arxiv.title: ASTOR: Benchmarking and Improving Autoformulation for Soft-Constraint Optimization with a Formal Grammar
arxiv.abstract: Real-world decision problems combine two qualitatively different kinds of constraints: requirements that must be satisfied, called hard constraints, and preferences that can be violated, called soft constraints. Because these problems are often posed to decision-makers in natural language, large language models offer a natural tool for assisting with their solution. This has given rise to autoformulation, which focuses on using LLMs to translate natural-language descriptions of decision problems into executable mathematical optimization models. However, this research often neglects soft constraints like those proposed by consumers, managers, and planners, despite the fact that many practical problems require modeling them explicitly. We introduce ASTOR, an inference-time framework that maps a natural-language decision problem to a grammar-guided abstract syntax tree (AST) before deterministically compiling the resulting representation into executable optimization code. We also introduce SoftOR, a unified benchmark of natural language problems which focuses on soft constraint formulations. On SoftOR, ASTOR achieves the best aggregate accuracy among comparable single-request and multi-agent LLM methods while remaining competitive on standard autoformulation benchmarks that include only hard constraints. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/astor-softor-iclr-E34C/README.md.
arxiv.titleZh: ASTOR:用形式文法为软约束优化的自动形式化建立基准并加以改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 现实决策问题同时包含必须满足的硬约束与可违反的软约束，而现有 LLM 自动形式化(把自然语言决策问题翻译为可执行优化模型)研究普遍忽略软约束。ASTOR 是一个推理时框架:先把自然语言问题映射为形式文法引导的抽象语法树(AST)，再确定性地编译为可执行的优化代码。作者同时发布聚焦软约束表述的统一基准 SoftOR;ASTOR 在该基准上取得同类单请求与多智能体 LLM 方法中最佳的聚合准确率，并在仅含硬约束的标准自动形式化基准上保持竞争力。
arxiv.reason: LLM 做优化建模的自动形式化，属文法约束生成与基准建设，方向擦边

arxiv.title: Next Best Action: Causal Constrained Offline RL for Business Action Targeting
arxiv.abstract: Next Best Action (NBA) systems must select among customer interventions (e.g., discounts, promotions, and lifecycle actions), maximize long-term economic value, satisfy complex operational constraints, and remain causally grounded. Existing approaches lack a rigorous framework for meeting these requirements jointly. We address this gap by formulating NBA as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP). We then integrate off-policy causal correction of the estimated customer dynamics directly into the Linear Programming (LP) formulation of the CMDP. The resulting policy selects actions based on customer states to maximize long-term value while explicitly enforcing business guardrails. Furthermore, the LP formulation yields shadow prices that quantify the economic trade-offs of operational constraints (e.g., fairness and user welfare), enhancing policy interpretability. We validate our proposed offline Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework on an industry case study involving rideshare coupon targeting, where customer states are defined by Recency, Frequency, and Monetary (RFM) stages. We evaluate performance using model-based off-policy evaluation, with causal dynamics estimated from a temporal holdout. Under the observed coupon budget and RFM state representation, our optimized policy improves customer lifetime value (LTV) by 19% over the estimated behavior policy and 8% over a myopic baseline. Although the demonstrated action space is binary, the proposed framework is action-agnostic, yielding a general-purpose decision module for targeting systems that manage multiple interventions.
arxiv.comment: Accepted for oral presentation at the ACM RecSys 2026 Workshop on Online and Adaptive Recommender System (OARS)
arxiv.titleZh: 下一最佳动作：用于商业动作定向的因果约束离线 RL
arxiv.summaryZh: 将下一最佳动作（NBA）的干预选择建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程，并把对客户动态估计的离策略因果校正直接嵌入该过程的线性规划求解中，由此得到的策略按客户状态选择动作，在最大化长期经济价值的同时显式满足公平性、用户福利等运营约束；线性规划的对偶变量（影子价格）还能量化各约束的经济代价，提升策略可解释性。在网约车优惠券定向的工业案例中，用基于模型的离策略评估，相较估计的行为策略将客户生命周期价值提升 19%，相较短视基线提升 8%。框架与动作空间无关，可推广到管理多种干预手段的定向系统；但目前动作空间仅为二值，且为 RecSys 研讨会论文。
arxiv.reason: 约束离线 RL 方法本身清晰，但属营销优惠券垂直应用，与 LLM 后训练、Agent 方向无交集

arxiv.title: Safety Mid-Training: Internalizing LLM Safety as a Foundational Capability
arxiv.abstract: Safety alignment for large language models (LLMs) is primarily performed during post-training, while recent work has also begun incorporating safety data into pre-training. Yet safety can degrade when later training no longer includes safety data, and gains in safety often come at the cost of general capability. This tension suggests that safety and general reasoning should not be treated as separate training goals. We instead view safety as an LLM capability that can be learned through a reasoning structure shared with general tasks. Both require the model to understand intent or task goals, apply relevant knowledge, and reason about potential consequences. We introduce safety mid-training, a stage between pre-training and post-training that jointly develops safety and general reasoning through this shared structure. Given safety and utility prompts, the base model generates structured documents and reasoning traces that are then used for mid-training. Safety mid-training reduces average attack success rate (ASR) by 72% to 81% relative to Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B base models, while also improving general capability. The benefits persist through subsequent post-training. After general-only SFT, mid-trained models largely retain their safety, achieving lower ASR than the baselines without sacrificing general capability. They also retain safety under general-only GRPO without safety rewards, while subsequent RL reaches a better safety-utility frontier when initialized from the mid-trained models. Together, these results suggest that learning safety and general reasoning within a shared mid-training stage can reduce the safety-utility trade-off and make safety more robust to subsequent training.
arxiv.titleZh: 安全中期训练:将 LLM 安全性内化为基础能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 现有安全对齐多在后训练阶段完成，一旦后续训练不含安全数据，安全性就会退化，且安全提升常以通用能力为代价。作者提出位于预训练与后训练之间的「安全中期训练」阶段，让基座模型针对安全与通用提示生成结构化文档与推理轨迹，以共享的推理结构(理解意图、调用知识、推断后果)同时发展安全与通用推理。相对 Qwen3-1.7B、4B、8B 基座模型，平均攻击成功率降低 72%–81%，通用能力亦有提升;经纯通用 SFT 与无安全奖励的 GRPO 后安全性基本保留，且由此初始化的 RL 能达到更优的安全-效用前沿。该工作为把安全性作为基础能力内化、缓解安全-效用权衡提供了可复用的训练范式。
arxiv.reason: 安全性中期训练新阶段，直接命中后训练与对齐方向，数据扎实

arxiv.title: Scaling Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Brain Encoding
arxiv.abstract: Brain encoding models aim to predict neural responses to stimuli. The most widely used approach fits readouts from frozen pretrained backbones. Using neural data to train large models from scratch or fully fine-tune them after task-pretraining has proven difficult because neural data is costly and limited. We show that parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) enables us to effectively adapt very large pretrained backbones for brain encoding with a small number of trainable parameters. To make it computationally practical, we exploit the backbone's causal structure to predict multiple timepoints in a single pass instead of using sliding windows, significantly reducing feature-extraction cost. This enables efficient fine-tuning of multimodal backbones with up to 104B parameters, the largest model adapted for brain encoding to our knowledge. Trained with a low-rank adapter (LoRA) and a lightweight readout, our approach consistently improves brain encoding performance across nine diverse multimodal backbones. On the same Qwen3-Omni backbone as the prior state-of-the-art (SoTA), our method BrainLoRA achieves the best published performance on the Algonauts 2025 Challenge. We also show the adapted multimodal backbones remain interpretable: modality attribution recovers the canonical sensory topography that prior work often obtains by construction from separate unimodal encoders, and neural adaptation increases the contribution of audio inputs and cross-modal mixing within the backbone. To scale out the number of adapted models, we develop a multi-LoRA kernel that accelerates joint training of multiple LoRAs on a shared backbone. This enables an ensemble of 200+ adapted models that ranks first on the public Algonauts post-challenge leaderboard at the time of writing. Together, our results highlight PEFT as an efficient and powerful paradigm for brain encoding.
arxiv.comment: 38 pages, 13 figures, 20 tables. Code available at https://github.com/zfying/brain-lora
arxiv.titleZh: 扩展参数高效微调用于大脑编码
arxiv.summaryZh: 大脑编码模型通常依赖冻结的预训练骨干网络提取特征后接读出层，而神经数据昂贵有限，难以从头训练或全量微调大模型。该工作用 LoRA 加轻量读出层对多模态骨干做参数高效微调，并利用骨干的因果结构一次前向预测多个时间点、替代滑窗，从而把可适配模型规模推到 104B 参数。在九个多模态骨干上性能一致提升，基于 Qwen3-Omni 的 BrainLoRA 取得 Algonauts 2025 挑战赛最佳已发表成绩；配合多 LoRA 联合训练 kernel 可集成 200+ 适配模型，登顶赛后公开榜单，并保持模态归因的可解释性。
arxiv.reason: LoRA 与多 LoRA 内核有参考价值，但任务是神经响应预测的垂直应用

arxiv.title: Learning to Refer: Inference-Time Collaboration in Decentralized Federated Learning
arxiv.abstract: In decentralized federated learning, heterogeneous clients may develop complementary expertise, yet each query is typically evaluated only by the client where it arrives. To exploit this distributed expertise without global coordination, we formulate inference-time collaboration as budgeted local expert referral, a graph-constrained routing process in which a query can move only between neighboring clients and only visited clients contribute to its final prediction. EdgeDRM implements this framework by learning a density-based routing potential for each client: differences between neighboring potentials provide the comparisons used to select successive referrals, while local task models generate predictions that are aggregated along the resulting route. Both training and inference are decentralized, using only neighbor-local information without a central router or graph-wide client scoring. We establish estimation guarantees for the learned comparisons and characterize how local improvement and graph structure govern prior-weighted density gains from referral. Experiments on benchmark and real-world medical data show that EdgeDRM outperforms graph-matched decentralized baselines in most settings, with the clearest benefits under sparse connectivity.
arxiv.titleZh: 学习转介：去中心化联邦学习中的推理时协作
arxiv.summaryZh: 去中心化联邦学习中的异构客户端往往各有所长，但查询通常只在它到达的客户端上被本地评估，无法利用其他客户端的专长。EdgeDRM 将推理时协作建模为「带预算的局部专家转介」：查询只能沿图在相邻客户端之间迁移，每个客户端学习基于密度的路由势，邻居之间的势差决定下一跳，沿途客户端的本地任务模型共同聚合出预测。训练与推理都只依赖邻居局部信息，不需要中心路由器或全局客户端打分，论文还给出所学比较的估计保证，并刻画局部改进与图结构如何影响转介带来的密度增益。在基准与真实医疗数据上，该方法在多数设置下优于图匹配的去中心化基线，连接稀疏时收益最明显。
arxiv.reason: 去中心化联邦学习推理路由，与 LLM 主线方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: Two hidden layer suffice: the caterpillar net
arxiv.abstract: Every continuous piecewise linear (CPWL) function is a finite signed sum of maxima of affine functions, making maximum representation a central problem in the study of the expressiveness of ReLU networks. A now-disproved conjecture predicted logarithmic depth for maxima. Inspired by the proof by Brunck et al. (2026) that two hidden layers suffice for general CPWL functions, we give the Caterpillar Net, a nonrecursive construction for the maximum of $N$ inputs with two hidden layers of widths $O(N^2)$ and $2^{O(N\log N)}$. The construction has a direct geometric interpretation.
arxiv.comment: 17 pages. Lean formalization and paper sources: https://github.com/JayPiZimmermann/Max_Caterpillar
arxiv.titleZh: 两个隐藏层足矣：Caterpillar网络
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对ReLU网络表达性中的最大值表示问题，给出非递归构造Caterpillar网络：用两个隐藏层计算N个输入的逐点最大值，两个隐藏层宽度分别为O(N^2)与2^{O(N log N)}，并提供直接的几何解释。该结果呼应近期“两个隐藏层足以表示任意连续分段线性（CPWL）函数”的证明，也替代了已被否定的对数深度猜想，为理解ReLU网络的深度—宽度权衡提供了显式构造。
arxiv.reason: ReLU网络表达性理论，与LLM架构仅弱相关

arxiv.title: On Data Scaling in Tabular ML: More Data, Better Generalization?
arxiv.abstract: Recent work in tabular machine learning has emphasized the importance of diverse and realistic evaluation settings. The niche of large-scale (1M+) data, however, remains under-explored. To study training-data scaling, we assemble eight real-world tabular datasets with up to around ten million training examples, retaining the natural distribution shifts of the tasks and using random-split evaluation as a control. We find that GBDTs and MLP-based models show broadly similar scaling trends, with gains from both additional training data and algorithmic improvements. Tabular foundation models show more varied scaling behavior, with recent versions benefiting more consistently from larger contexts even under distribution shift. However, scaling training data under distribution shift introduces new challenges: in-distribution and out-of-distribution performance mostly improve together at smaller scales but can diverge at larger scales. We examine this through MLP capacity sweeps and comparisons of the validation distributions used for tuning and early stopping in MLPs and GBDTs. We also compare common practices of using validation data, contrasting its use for model selection in MLP pipelines with using it for in-context fitting in tabular foundation model pipelines. Under stronger shifts, MLPs selected using validation representative of the evaluation conditions generally maintain or improve performance as training data grows. In contrast, including such examples in context improves foundation-model performance, but does not prevent deterioration with increasing training size in our experiments.
arxiv.titleZh: 表格机器学习中的数据缩放：更多数据，更好泛化？
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对表格机器学习中百万级样本以上的数据缩放研究不足，构建八个真实表格数据集（最多约一千万训练样本），保留自然分布偏移并以随机划分作为对照。实验显示GBDT与MLP的缩放趋势相近，额外数据与算法改进都带来收益；表格基础模型的缩放行为更多样，较新版本在分布偏移下更稳定地从更大上下文中获益。但大规模下分布内与分布外性能可能分离，验证集用于MLP模型选择与用于基础模型上下文拟合的效果不同：强偏移下，采用贴近评测条件的验证集选择MLP通常能随训练数据增长保持或提升性能，而上下文示例不能阻止基础模型随训练规模增大而退化。
arxiv.reason: 表格数据缩放，与LLM后训练/Agent主线关联弱

arxiv.title: SOMA: Continuous Monitoring and Intervention for System Two Reasoning with System One Models
arxiv.abstract: Reasoning models often run into problems without noticing them, even when symptoms are visible in their own text. In humans, metacognition separates monitoring from control: fast, intuitive signals keep watch while slow, deliberate reasoning unfolds and help decide whether to continue, change course, or stop. System One (S1) decision models, such as Jev, are a natural candidate for this role: they return a calibrated probability for a natural-language question about a text in one fast call, yet they are used only as gates before reasoning. We introduce SOMA (System One Metacognitive Awareness), in which an S1 model continuously monitors a System Two (S2) reasoning model and intervenes when needed. SOMA has three layers: a scenario layer states each objective in natural language with predefined actions, an awareness layer lets S1 judge whether the described behavior appears, and a control layer accumulates these judgments, first reminds S2, and takes over only if the behavior persists. Sharing one S1 model and one controller across tasks, without training, SOMA addresses two different failures on two reasoning models: on overthinking, it cuts reasoning tokens by up to 36\% while improving average accuracy, and on unanswerable questions, it raises abstention from 70.5\% to 87.2\%.
arxiv.titleZh: SOMA：用 System One 模型对 System Two 推理进行持续监控与干预
arxiv.summaryZh: 推理模型常在自身文本已暴露症状时仍不自知地跑偏（过思考、对不可回答问题强行作答）。SOMA 分三层：场景层用自然语言陈述目标与可选动作，觉察层让 S1 判定模型（如 Jev）一次调用即给出校准概率、判断目标行为是否出现，控制层累积这些判断，先提醒 S2，行为持续才接管。共享同一 S1 与控制器、无需训练，在两个推理模型上把过思考的推理 token 削减最多 36% 且平均准确率上升，不可回答问题上的弃答率由 70.5% 提升到 87.2%。工作把廉价 S1 模型从推理前的门控扩展为贯穿全程的元认知监控器，为推理时控制提供了通用轻量方案。
arxiv.reason: 推理时监控与干预机制新颖，命中推理效率与 test-time scaling 方向

arxiv.title: Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Training a machine learning (ML) model is an optimization process that typically requires a set of examples with ground-truth labels beforehand. Obtaining these ground truths usually requires laborious human effort and can be costly. The scalability of human labeling becomes a concern when there are a large number of data points that need to be labeled. To address this practical issue, we consider an optimization setting where a subset of samples has ground-truth labels, while the remaining data points were labeled by an ML predictor, which could potentially assign incorrect labels to those points. We propose both first-order and zeroth-order stochastic optimization methods for training on datasets consisting of a mix of true-labeled and ML-labeled samples. We further conduct comprehensive empirical studies from training a linear regression model to fine-tuning a large language model (LLM) to showcase the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms for training with ML-labeled data.
arxiv.titleZh: 利用机器学习标注数据、通过随机一阶与零阶优化进行训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 真标签获取成本高、人工标注难以规模化扩展，因此考虑训练数据由一部分真标签样本与大量由ML预测器标注（可能出错）的样本混合构成时的优化设定；提出分别基于随机一阶梯度与零阶梯度的优化方法，使训练在此类混合标注数据上更稳健。实验从线性回归模型一直覆盖到大型语言模型微调，验证了所提算法在ML标注数据上训练的有效性。适用于标签噪声学习与低显存零阶微调等场景。
arxiv.reason: 混合标注数据的随机一阶/零阶优化，与LLM微调沾边但主体偏优化理论

arxiv.title: LG-Bench: A Graph-Structured Evaluation Benchmark for Life Sciences
arxiv.abstract: Traditional evaluation benchmarks reduce inherently interconnected scientific knowledge in life sciences into flat lists of questions, disregarding the underlying topological structure of the knowledge. We introduce, the first graph-structured benchmark for life sciences, featuring over 10,000 high-quality multiple-choice questions across medicine, biology, and chemistry. Our approach constructs a weighted evaluation graph using bidirectional matching and semantic similarity algorithms, where nodes represent questions and edge weights capture their semantic relationships. Leveraging this graph topology, we design two novel evaluation metrics. The Global Coherence Score (GCS) measures a model's consistency within semantically related neighborhoods, while Knowledge Balance Score (KBS) analyzes how model errors are distributed across the graph to reveal conceptual blind spots. LG-Bench facilitates fine-grained comparison of LLMs by surfacing differences in conceptual coherence and patterns of knowledge organization across models. Our framework shifts the evaluation paradigm from flat accuracy metrics to structure-aware analysis, offering a new lens for diagnosing and improving LLM performance in the life sciences domain.
arxiv.titleZh: LG-Bench：面向生命科学的图结构评测基准
arxiv.summaryZh: 把生命科学中相互关联的知识压缩成扁平题目清单，会丢掉知识本身的拓扑结构；为此构建首个图结构评测基准，覆盖医学、生物、化学等学科逾 10,000 道高质量选择题。方法上用双向匹配与语义相似度算法构建带权评测图，节点为题目、边权刻画语义关联，并基于该拓扑设计两个新指标：全局连贯性分数（GCS）衡量模型在语义邻近邻域内作答的一致性，知识均衡分数（KBS）分析错误在图上的分布以暴露概念盲区。该框架把评测从平面准确率推进到结构感知分析，可细粒度区分模型在概念连贯性与知识组织方式上的差异，适用于诊断并改进 LLM 在垂直科学领域的表现。
arxiv.reason: 评测方法学有新意，但落在生命科学垂直域

arxiv.title: RESIN: Multi-Chain Reasoning with Entity-Structured Indexing
arxiv.abstract: Multi-chain reasoning is a challenging task not only because the multi-chain evidence is dispersed, but also because different parts of reasoning may require distinct, interacting chains of support. Flat retrieval can flood a model with loosely related text, whereas early selection of a single reasoning path can discard evidence that becomes useful only after other facts are considered. We introduce RESIN (Reasoning with Entity Structured Indexing), which uses structure to locate evidence while keeping the original source as the basis for reasoning. RESIN decomposes a question into focused one-hop needs, retrieves a small set of source-grounded units for each hop, and places only this relevant evidence in a compact reasoning buffer. The buffer preserves alternative supports until final composition, making intermediate decisions explicit without forcing a brittle path. On the full HolisQA benchmark, RESIN achieves 82.92 context recall and 76.70 answer relevancy over all questions, with higher reported CR and AR across five domains and higher F1 in four domains than the published baselines. Ablations show that both typed evidence diversity and hop-wise decomposition are essential, supporting a clear conclusion: Precise evidence organization and delayed commitment make multi-chain reasoning effective and auditable. Our code is available at https://github.com/RamonMeng/RESIN.
arxiv.titleZh: RESIN:基于实体结构化索引的多链推理
arxiv.summaryZh: 多链推理的难点在于证据分散且各推理环节需要彼此交互的支撑链:扁平检索会灌入大量弱相关文本，而过早锁定单条推理路径又会丢弃后续才有用的证据。RESIN 在保持原始来源作为推理依据的前提下，用结构定位证据:把问题分解为聚焦的单跳需求，每一跳只检索少量有来源依据的单元，并把这些证据放入紧凑的推理缓冲区，在最终组合前保留多种候选支撑，从而延迟承诺、让中间决策显式可查。在完整的 HolisQA 基准上，全部问题取得 82.92 的 context recall 与 76.70 的 answer relevancy，五个领域上的 CR/AR 均更高，四个领域的 F1 超过已发表基线;消融显示类型化证据多样性与逐跳分解均为必要组件。该工作适用于需要可审计多跳检索与证据组织的 RAG 场景。
arxiv.reason: 多跳检索与推理证据组织，RAG 推理方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility: A Theoretical Framework for Multi-Agent Task Obstructions
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent systems can differ under identical agents and communication budgets when they support different forms of joint interaction. We introduce Topological Sheaves of Irreducibility (TSI), a sheaf-theoretic framework separating task-level compatibility obstructions from system capability. A task is represented by an interaction complex $K$ and a capacity sheaf $\mathcal{F}$; nonzero $H^n(K;\mathcal{F})$ defines a structural signature, while registered interventions test capability. For cocycle data, cochain realization is solvable exactly when the represented cohomology class vanishes. Examples show that the signature is sheaf-relative, and the degree-1 reduction yields cycle-space witnesses and observation requirements. We evaluate two finite one-round models. Across 15,625 degree-1 inputs, an all-agent additive primitive solves decision and repair exactly; the optimal pairwise system reaches 88.80% on decision, one input above the 88.79% majority-class baseline, and 26.63% on repair. On a degree-2 tetrahedral-boundary task over 531,441 inputs, the same-2-skeleton system retains all four three-agent primitives yet matches the pairwise-only optimum throughout the registered separation window, whereas adding the class-filling four-agent primitive makes both tasks exact. Status-preserving robustness checks retain exact performance but are not cost-matched to the class-restoring ablation. Conditional on the registered primitives and cost models, TSI provides task-relative, falsifiable tests of higher-order interaction.
arxiv.titleZh: 不可约性的拓扑层：多智能体任务障碍的理论框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 相同智能体与相同通信预算下，多智能体系统仍可能因支持的联合交互形式不同而表现不同；需要把任务层面的兼容性障碍与系统自身能力区分开。本文用交互复形K与容量层F表示任务，以非零上同调H^n(K;F)作为结构签名，并用注册干预检验能力：上链实现可精确求解当且仅当所表示的上同调类消失，1阶约化给出cycle-space见证与观测需求。在15,625个1阶输入上，全智能体可加原语精确求解决策与修复，最优成对系统的决策准确率为88.80%，仅比88.79%的多数类基线高一个输入，修复准确率为26.63%；在531,441个输入的2阶四面体边界任务上，同2-骨架系统保留全部四个三智能体原语，但在整个注册分离窗口内与仅成对最优持平，加入填充类四智能体原语后两个任务均精确。该框架在给定原语与代价模型下，为高阶交互提供任务相对、可证伪的检验。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体理论框架，但纯拓扑形式化，与 LLM Agent 实践距离远

arxiv.title: Monsoon: Scalable Spontaneous Speech Collection for Low-Resource ASR in 50 Languages
arxiv.abstract: For most languages, automatic speech recognition (ASR) is limited less by model architecture than by a lack of accurately transcribed spontaneous speech. We present Monsoon, a framework for collecting such data at scale. It elicits unscripted conversations between paired contributors, screens recordings with automated classifiers, corrects transcripts over five levels of human review, and selects segments for lexical and acoustic coverage. It has collected speech in 50 languages; we analyse seven 3,500-hour corpora. At equal volume, its quality stages reduce semantic word error rate (WER) by 10-39% relative to a conventional protocol. Compared with an architecture-matched baseline trained on public corpora, Whisper fine-tuned on Monsoon performs comparably on the baseline's own test sets and reduces semantic WER by 20-44 points on conversational benchmarks. The gains transfer to a second architecture and grow with data volume. We release the framework, its quality-control models, and the fine-tuned models.
arxiv.titleZh: Monsoon：面向 50 种低资源语言的可扩展自发语音采集框架
arxiv.summaryZh: 低资源语言的 ASR 瓶颈主要在缺乏准确转写的自发语音数据，而非模型架构。Monsoon 让配对参与者进行无脚本对话，用自动分类器筛选录音，经五级人工复核纠正转写，并按词汇与声学覆盖度挑选片段。在 50 种语言上采集语音，并分析其中七个各 3500 小时的语料：同等数据量下，其质量流程使语义 WER 相对传统协议降低 10–39%；基于 Monsoon 微调的 Whisper 在基线自身测试集上表现相当，在对话基准上语义 WER 降低 20–44 个百分点，且收益可迁移到第二种架构并随数据量增长。
arxiv.reason: 面向低资源语言的语音采集与 ASR，属语音应用方向，不匹配关注画像

arxiv.title: HarnessPro: Recursive Harness Self-Improvement with Pareto Optimization for Performance-Cost Trade-offs
arxiv.abstract: Harness development plays a crucial role in building capable AI agents. Recent approaches improve harnesses through recursive self-improvement (RSI), but their performance gains often come with higher execution costs. We introduce HarnessPro, a label-free method for evolving harnesses to improve task performance while reducing execution cost. In this setting, candidate harnesses are evaluated using LLM-generated tests without access to ground-truth solutions or official tests. Specialized agents diagnose execution trajectories, plan updates with different performance-cost priorities, and implement them as candidate harnesses. Rather than returning a single harness, HarnessPro uses normalized weighted squared-distance selection to provide cost-focused (lite), balanced (medium), and performance-focused (heavy) harnesses for different deployment budgets. Selected harnesses enter the next iteration, where execution feedback guides further updates. Our experiments cover Terminal-Bench 2, SWE-Bench Pro, and ProgramBench, using GPT-5.5 with Codex and GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Across these benchmarks using GPT-5.5 with Codex, the heavy mode of HarnessPro achieves an average pass-rate gain of 2.0 percentage points and an average per-task cost reduction of 26.1% relative to RHO. This advantage also holds when using GLM-5.2 with Claude Code. Code is available at https://github.com/pzs19/HarnessPro
arxiv.titleZh: HarnessPro:基于 Pareto 优化的递归 Harness 自我改进，兼顾性能与成本权衡
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对递归自我改进(RSI)提升 agent harness 时执行成本同步上涨的问题，提出无标签的 harness 进化方法:由专门化的 agent 诊断执行轨迹、按不同性能—成本偏好规划并实现候选 harness，并用归一化加权平方距离选择同时输出 lite、medium、heavy 三档 Pareto 方案供不同部署预算使用。在 Terminal-Bench 2、SWE-Bench Pro、ProgramBench 上，以 GPT-5.5+Codex 为基座时 heavy 模式相对 RHO 平均通过率提升 2.0 个百分点、单任务成本下降 26.1%，换用 GLM-5.2+Claude Code 结论依然成立。该工作把 harness 自动优化从单一性能目标推进到显式的性能—成本权衡，对 agent scaffold 工程有直接参考价值。
arxiv.reason: Agent harness 自进化+Pareto 成本权衡，直接命中 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: Simulation Priors for Rapid Adaptation in Model-Based RL for Autonomous Racing
arxiv.abstract: Reinforcement learning enables learning high-performance control policies, but its reliance on extensive interaction limits deployment on physical systems where data collection is costly, and failures are unsafe. We introduce Prior-Informed Adaptation (PIA), an offline-to-online model-based RL framework that uses structured simulation priors for rapid adaptation. PIA pretrains a world model on heterogeneous low- and high-fidelity simulated trajectories, then adapts it with limited target-domain interaction using uncertainty-regularized planning. Rather than requiring an accurate simulator for policy transfer, PIA treats simulated trajectories as biased priors whose residual mismatch is corrected during online adaptation. We evaluate PIA in autonomous racing using high-fidelity simulation and on a real full-size autonomous race car. In simulation, PIA adapts faster across track and surface shifts than strong baselines, achieving lower lap times and fewer failures. On hardware, PIA achieves reliable few-shot adaptation with less than one hour of on-vehicle interaction.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向自主赛车的基于模型 RL 中用于快速适应的仿真先验
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对强化学习在真实系统上数据采集昂贵、失败不安全的问题，提出离线到在线的基于模型 RL 框架 Prior-Informed Adaptation(PIA):先在混合高低保真仿真轨迹上预训练世界模型，再借助不确定性正则化规划，用有限目标域交互进行在线校正，把仿真轨迹当作有偏先验而非要求精确的仿真器。在自主赛车场景中，仿真里跨赛道与路面变化的适应速度快于强基线，圈时更低、失败更少;实车全尺寸赛车上不到一小时交互即完成可靠的少样本适应。
arxiv.reason: 基于模型 RL 用于自主赛车控制，属机器人控制方向，不关注

arxiv.title: TokenGate: Adapting LLMs for Fast and Memory-Efficient Prefill with Learned Token Pruning
arxiv.abstract: Expert human readers process large inputs (e.g., code repositories and long documents) by skimming to closely read only what matters. On the other hand, language models process all input tokens through each model layer, resulting in significant processing costs for long-context inputs. We introduce TokenGate, a small, drop-in component that extends existing trained models to enable end-to-end learnable token pruning over long-context inputs for fast and memory-efficient prefill. To enable end-to-end learning despite the non-differentiable top-K operator for token pruning, we introduce token-gated attention, a mechanism inspired by Mixture-of-Experts that re-weights attention logits using token importance scores. Across diverse tasks, TokenGate achieves $1.4$-$11.3\times$ faster time-to-first token (TTFT) and $1.5$-$3.4\times$ lower peak memory at no accuracy degradation for prefill in transformers. Compared to the best-performing prior methods for token-pruning, TokenGate gives up to $6.4\times$ faster prefill and $2\times$ lower peak memory. TokenGate natively extends both standard transformers (e.g., Qwen3) and hybrid-attention models (e.g., Qwen3.5) with simple lightweight adaptation comparable to standard parameter-efficient fine-tuning. We make our code available at: https://github.com/tokengate-models/TokenGate.
arxiv.titleZh: TokenGate:让 LLM 通过可学习 token 剪枝实现快速且省显存的 prefill
arxiv.summaryZh: 长上下文输入下，LLM 需将全部 token 逐层计算，prefill 开销大。TokenGate 是一个可即插即用的小型组件，为已训练模型加上端到端可学习的 token 剪枝:针对 top-K 剪枝不可微的问题，提出受 MoE 启发的 token-gated attention，用 token 重要性分数重加权注意力 logits。在多种任务上，TTFT 加速 1.4–11.3 倍、峰值显存降低 1.5–3.4 倍且精度无损，相比此前最佳剪枝方法 prefill 最多快 6.4 倍;可原生扩展到 Qwen3 等标准 Transformer 与 Qwen3.5 等混合注意力模型，适配成本与常规参数高效微调相当。
arxiv.reason: 长上下文 prefill 效率与可学习 token 剪枝，命中架构与系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Trajectory Replay: Continuous-Time Mixture Transport for Lifelong Generative Models
arxiv.abstract: Adapting pre-trained continuous-time generative models to sequentially incoming data without forgetting earlier tasks is a central challenge in lifelong learning. A leading strategy, generative replay, uses a generative model trained on historical tasks to augment its own continual update with synthetic samples from experience. However, it requires full trajectory simulations at every training step, which accumulate discretization errors and can degrade the replayed historical distribution. Here, we propose trajectory replay, which bypasses sample generation by training an updated velocity field to match both a frozen historical velocity along its trajectories and the incoming task's velocity field, weighted by a stability-plasticity coefficient. Through the lens of continuous-time transport, we show the resulting optimum averages the two task velocities by their respective densities and generates the mixture of their probability paths. Combined with mean velocity distillation, trajectory replay accesses historical trajectories using only a few network evaluations per continual update. Empirically, it outperforms generative replay and distillation baselines on class-incremental image generation. In two biological case studies, trajectory replay extends generative perturbation models to new contexts and experimental batches across two data modalities while preserving treatment-effect prediction.
arxiv.titleZh: 轨迹回放:面向终身生成模型的连续时间混合传输
arxiv.summaryZh: 将预训练的连续时间生成模型适配到依次到来的数据而不遗忘旧任务，是终身学习的核心难题;主流做法生成式回放需在每个训练步做完整轨迹仿真，离散化误差累积会劣化回放的历史分布。轨迹回放改为直接训练更新后的速度场，同时拟合冻结历史速度场沿其轨迹的取值与新区任务的速度场，并以稳定性—可塑性系数加权;从连续时间传输视角可证明其最优解按各自密度对两个任务速度做平均，生成二者概率路径的混合。配合平均速度蒸馏，每次持续更新只需少量网络前向即可访问历史轨迹。在类增量图像生成上优于生成式回放与蒸馏基线，并在两个生物扰动建模案例中把模型扩展到新情境与实验批次且保持处理效应预测。
arxiv.reason: 扩散/流匹配生成建模与图像生成，属低分方向

arxiv.title: recAMPLIFY: Large-Scale Pretraining of Recursive Protein Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Protein language models (pLMs) are powerful tools for protein annotation and mutation-effect prediction, but progress has largely depended on scaling model size and data, making them expensive and prone to memorization. Test-time scaling offers a complementary path, but methods developed for autoregressive LLMs do not transfer directly: masked encoders lack a generation loop, and amino acids do not verbalize in a reasoning language. Instead, we adapt recursive pretraining to masked pLMs, where a weight-tied Transformer core refines residue-aligned hidden states over an adjustable number of cycles. We instantiate this recipe as recAMPLIFY, a pLM with 155M unique parameters trained on the same 2T tokens as AMPLIFY-350M. Despite 56% fewer parameters, it improves CASP contact recovery and three out of four supervised tasks, notably raising fold accuracy by 22.5%. Because optimal depth for recAMPLIFY varies across tasks and assays, we then introduce Gated Mixture Recurrence (GMR), a framework that decodes each protein from a probability-weighted mixture of hidden states visited during recursion. GMR employs a learned residual gate at scalar, low-rank, or per-dimension resolution to control how much of each cycle's proposed update is accepted into the state. This unifies halting and gating into a single adaptive computation objective while recovering PonderNet-style halting as a special case without gates. Layered on top of recAMPLIFY, GMR further reduces expected layer depth by up to 37%, although the accuracy trade-off varies by task. Mechanistic analyses show that residual gating controls recurrence stability beyond the trained depth and that halt depth tracks biological properties.
arxiv.titleZh: recAMPLIFY：递归蛋白质语言模型的大规模预训练
arxiv.summaryZh: 蛋白质语言模型的进展主要依赖扩大模型与数据规模，成本高且容易记忆训练数据。该工作把递归预训练引入掩码 pLM：权重共享的 Transformer 核心在可调循环次数下反复精炼与残基对齐的隐状态。实例化模型 recAMPLIFY 仅 155M 唯一参数，训练 token 数与 AMPLIFY-350M 相同（2T），参数少 56%，却在 CASP 接触恢复和四项监督任务中的三项上更优，折叠准确率提升 22.5%。进一步提出的 Gated Mixture Recurrence 用标量、低秩或逐维的残差门控，按概率加权混合递归过程中访问的隐状态，把停机与门控统一为单一自适应计算目标，可将期望层深最多降低 37%；机制分析显示，残差门控决定超出训练深度的递归稳定性，停机深度与生物性质相关。
arxiv.reason: 蛋白质语言模型属低分方向，仅递归深度与自适应计算沾架构边

arxiv.title: CAVA: Complementary-Label-Aware Data Valuation
arxiv.abstract: Complementary-label learning (CLL) trains a classifier from labels that name a class an instance does not belong to. Such labels are cheap to collect from crowdworkers or vision-language models (VLMs), making them attractive for large-scale annotation. However, both sources can mistakenly assign the true class as the complementary label. Such annotation errors are particularly harmful in CLL because the model is explicitly trained to suppress the correct answer. Optimal transport (OT) data valuation identifies harmful samples by comparing training data with a clean validation set, but transferring it directly to CLL creates a semantic mismatch: label $c$ means not class $c$ in the training but class $c$ in the validation. We show that this makes the OT label groups noisy mixtures whose behavior depends on the noise rate. The transferred score is informative only at sufficiently high noise, becomes uninformative at the crossover rate $1/M$ for $M$ classes, and reverses below it, where practical CLL annotation typically operates. We propose CAVA, which introduces a complementary label cost and a label margin that isolates the contribution of each complementary label to the transport potential. The margin keeps a consistent direction across noise rates, detects diagonal noise with a parameter-free threshold of closed-form precision, and allows detected samples to be recycled as ordinary-label supervision. On synthetic and human-annotated benchmarks, CAVA separates diagonal noise almost perfectly where directly transferred OT valuation performs worse than random. With only a fraction of the clean validation data, it also improves every CLL objective we evaluate, showing that OT-based valuation becomes reliable once the semantics of complementary supervision are modeled explicitly.
arxiv.titleZh: CAVA:互补标签感知的数据估值
arxiv.summaryZh: 互补标签学习用「不属于某类」的廉价标注训练分类器（众包与 VLM 标注均易得），但标注者可能误把真实类别写成互补标签，而 CLL 恰恰显式压制正确答案，这类错误危害极大。把最优传输（OT）数据估值直接迁移到 CLL 会因标签语义错配（训练中 c 表示「非 c」、验证中表示「是 c」）使 OT 标签组成为噪声混合，传输得分仅在噪声率足够高时有效，在 1/M 交叉点失效、在其下（实际 CLL 标注常见区间）方向反转。CAVA 引入互补标签代价与标签边际，隔离每个互补标签对传输势的贡献，使边际在各噪声率下方向一致，并以无参数闭式阈值检测对角噪声、把检测出的样本回收为普通标签监督。在合成与人工标注基准上，CAVA 几乎完美分离对角噪声（直接迁移的 OT 估值则差于随机），且仅用部分干净验证集即提升所评估的全部 CLL 目标。
arxiv.reason: 互补标签噪声与数据估值，与 LLM 主线无交集，仅沾 VLM 标注来源的边

arxiv.title: Cross-Fitting for Neural Posterior Estimation
arxiv.abstract: Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE) fits an amortized conditional density estimator to a simulated training set of complete-data realizations. NPE's training objective, log-likelihood, favors posterior approximations that assign arbitrarily high density to the training points, and typical families of amortized conditional density estimators (e.g., normalizing flows, Gaussian encoders) are flexible enough to oblige. The resulting policy of extreme overconfidence translates poorly to held-out data. Early stopping and other regularizers can prevent this degeneracy, but they are limited to selecting posterior approximations along an unfavorable optimization trajectory set by in-sample residuals, where the posterior mean is underfit while the posterior variance is overfit. To avoid this trade-off, we propose Cross-Fitting NPE (CF-NPE), which uses sample splitting to separate conditional-mean estimation from the estimation of the posterior's higher moments. Using $K$-fold cross-fitting, CF-NPE fits $K$ posterior-mean regressors and then fits a conditional density estimator to the resulting out-of-fold residuals. In experiments with synthetic data and in a cosmological application, CF-NPE achieves higher held-out log-likelihood than standard NPE and typically improves calibration. CF-NPE is most useful in high-dimensional, simulation-limited settings.
arxiv.titleZh: 神经后验估计中的交叉拟合
arxiv.summaryZh: 神经后验估计(NPE)以完整模拟数据的对数似然为训练目标，会让归一化流等柔性密度估计器给训练点赋予任意高的密度，后验均值欠拟合并方差过拟合，在留出数据上表现为过度自信。CF-NPE 用样本分割把条件均值估计与后验高阶矩的估计解耦:通过 K 折交叉拟合训练 K 个后验均值回归器，再对折外残差拟合条件密度估计器。在合成数据与一个宇宙学应用中，该方法的留出对数似然高于标准 NPE，校准通常也更好，尤其适用于高维、模拟预算受限的场景。
arxiv.reason: 贝叶斯后验估计的统计方法，与 LLM 关注方向基本无交集

arxiv.title: EpiLens: Lightweight RAG for Epidemiological Knowledge Acquisition
arxiv.abstract: To prepare for future outbreaks, researchers need to know what studies have been done and what data they use. Mapping a large literature by hand is slow, while large language models alone can misstate or conflate sources. We present EpiLens, a lightweight, open-source retrieval-augmented generation package that applies a fixed retrieval template and output schema to every paper in a corpus and links outputs to source passages. We build a corpus of 2,297 papers from the sources of a multi-pathogen parameter study and evaluate EpiLens's paper-classification workflow against 214 manually labelled papers. Without task-specific training data, the classifier matches or exceeds the tested supervised and zero-shot baselines across four tasks. The study's early extraction sheets cite published sources for 327 estimates. We link each estimate to a cited document or to corpus studies included by a review. Then, we use the classifier's labels to compare the papers associated with different parameters and pathogens. EpiLens labels more papers linked to reproduction numbers than fatality risks as model-based (54% versus 22%, compared with 62% versus 24% in the manual labels). The gap is consistent with the frequent use of transmission models to estimate reproduction numbers and persists within each of five pathogens compared. Beyond the contrast between parameters, the model-based share of papers linked to incubation-period estimates differs by pathogen: 55% for SARS-CoV-2 versus 6% for mpox.
arxiv.titleZh: EpiLens：面向流行病学知识获取的轻量级RAG
arxiv.summaryZh: 手工梳理大规模文献以摸清已有研究与数据来源耗时漫长，而单用大模型又容易张冠李戴或混淆出处。EpiLens以开源轻量RAG包实现：对语料中每篇论文套用固定检索模板与输出schema，并将每条输出链接回原文段落。作者从一项多病原体参数研究的引文构建2297篇论文语料，在214篇人工标注上评测分类流程，四个任务上无需任务特定训练数据即匹配或超过监督与零样本基线。抽取表涉及327个估计值，逐一链接到所引文献或综述纳入的语料研究，并据此比较不同参数与病原体下论文的建模比例（再生数54%对病死率22%，人工标注为62%对24%）。
arxiv.reason: RAG方法可用，但落在流行病学文献挖掘的垂直应用

arxiv.title: Copying Under Repetition: From Prefix Matching to Position Hashing
arxiv.abstract: Frontier LLMs can copy random text almost flawlessly, yet they often overrun or truncate long blocks of repeated characters. In repeated strings, matching local content no longer reliably identifies where copying should continue or when it should stop. Nevertheless, we show that a two-layer transformer with $O(\log\log N)$-bit precision and $O(\log N/\log\log N)$ width can copy every string up to a chosen design horizon $N$ and terminate correctly under arbitrary repetition. We use RoPE-style rotations of attention values and outputs (VO-rotations) with small prime periods to encode distances from delimiter anchors modulo those primes. By the Chinese Remainder Theorem, these periodic encodings jointly distinguish all required distances, allowing one retrieval rule to select either the next source token or the end marker. In contrast, we prove a width-independent impossibility result for copying under sequential finite-precision softmax accumulation. It applies to transformers whose only positional input is an additive attention bias that eventually becomes constant, including NoPE and a recursive implementation of ALiBi. Once an identical-token run exceeds the resulting saturation threshold, further repetitions leave the logits unchanged. If this threshold grows sublinearly with $N$, these models cannot both complete a long all-identical copy and stop correctly, a pattern resembling the termination errors of frontier LLMs. In synthetic copying experiments, baseline transformer models fail on long repeated strings even within the training range. Trained VO models, by contrast, generalize beyond the training lengths with near-perfect accuracy up to length $\approx 5005$, the selected primes' period product.
arxiv.titleZh: 重复下的复制：从前缀匹配到位置哈希
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对LLM在长重复字符串上易过冲或截断的问题，用带小素数周期的RoPE式注意力值与输出旋转（VO-rotations）编码到分隔符锚点的距离，并借中国剩余定理让检索规则选择下一源token或结束标记；两层Transformer仅需O(log log N)位精度和O(log N/log log N)宽度即可复制至设计视界N的字符串并正确终止。还证明仅靠最终为常数的加性注意力偏置（含NoPE与递归ALiBi）的有限精度softmax累积存在宽度无关的不可能性：同token连续段超过饱和阈值后logits不再变化，若阈值随N亚线性增长则无法兼顾长全同复制与正确停止。合成实验中基线在训练范围内即失败，VO模型外推到约5005（所选素数周期乘积）仍近完美。
arxiv.reason: Transformer位置编码与复制理论，直击长上下文机制

arxiv.title: Deep Pontryagin Learning for Continuous-Time Stochastic Control with Jumps
arxiv.abstract: We develop a deep Pontryagin learning framework for high-dimensional continuous-time stochastic control problems that naturally accommodates jump-diffusions. In contrast to direct policy optimization, which repeatedly differentiates the objective through the entire time-discretized dynamics, our method separates adjoint learning from policy improvement by explicitly incorporating state-sensitivity information from the Pontryagin stochastic maximum principle. For a fixed Markov control, we first compute pathwise adjoint labels by backpropagating the reward through time along simulated state trajectories, and project these labels onto the Markov state through a supervised regression step. The control is then updated by enforcing the pointwise Hamiltonian stationarity condition. We prove that the resulting projected adjoint process satisfies a discrete-time Pontryagin principle and converges, as the time step tends to zero, to the solution of the corresponding continuous-time adjoint backward stochastic differential equation. Numerical experiments illustrate the accuracy, stability, and scalability of the approach.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向含跳跃连续时间随机控制的深度 Pontryagin 学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对高维连续时间随机控制问题（含跳跃扩散），提出深度 Pontryagin 学习框架：对固定的 Markov 控制，先沿模拟状态轨迹将奖励反传得到路径型伴随标签，再通过监督回归把标签投影到 Markov 状态上，随后依据逐点 Hamiltonian 平稳性条件更新控制，从而将伴随学习与策略改进解耦，避免直接策略优化中反复穿越整条离散动力学求导。理论部分证明投影伴随过程满足离散时间 Pontryagin 原理，且时间步趋于零时收敛到连续时间伴随 BSDE 的解；数值实验展示了精度、稳定性与可扩展性。
arxiv.reason: 连续时间随机控制的伴随法，与 LLM 主线基本无关

arxiv.title: HoloCosm: Beyond Single-Metric Benchmark Compression Across Multiple Metrics
arxiv.abstract: Benchmark compression reduces evaluation cost by selecting a small set of samples. Existing methods typically guide selection using a single metric, although benchmarks often assess models along multiple dimensions. We find that model rankings are often weakly correlated across metrics, indicating that different metrics capture distinct aspects of model performance. Samples selected for one metric do not reliably preserve scores and rankings on others when used for compressed evaluation. At 80\% compression, each of the five single-metric baselines yields higher reconstruction error than equal-size random sampling in over 70\% of cross-metric comparisons. To address this challenge, we present HoloCosm, which jointly minimizes normalized score-reconstruction error across source models and metrics while constraining ranking distortion. We evaluate HoloCosm across multiple compression rates on 15 language, multimodal, VLA, and agent benchmark configurations with 85 component metrics. With 80\% compression, HoloCosm outperforms Random, the strongest baseline overall: average NMAE drops by 35.3\% to 0.236, worst-component NMAE drops by 39.5\% to 0.330, and average Spearman correlation rises from 0.884 to 0.915. In addition, HoloCosm remains competitive with existing baselines in single-metric evaluation. We will release our code and experimental results.
arxiv.titleZh: HoloCosm：跨多指标超越单指标基准压缩
arxiv.summaryZh: 基准压缩通过挑选少量样本降低评测成本，但现有方法通常只按单一指标选样；模型排名在不同指标间往往仅弱相关，导致按某一指标选出的样本在其他指标上无法可靠保留分数与排名，80%压缩率下五种单指标基线在超过70%的跨指标比较中重构误差高于等规模随机采样。HoloCosm联合最小化源模型与各指标上的归一化分数重构误差，同时约束排名失真。在15个语言、多模态、VLA与Agent基准配置共85个分量指标上，80%压缩率下平均NMAE降至0.236（较最强基线Random降低35.3%），最差分量NMAE降至0.330，平均Spearman相关从0.884升至0.915，并在单指标评测中保持竞争力。
arxiv.reason: 多指标基准压缩，评测方法学方向扎实工作

arxiv.title: Doubly Robust Learning of Heterogeneous Survival Treatment Effects under Time-Varying Treatments
arxiv.abstract: Estimating heterogeneous survival treatment effects (HSTEs) from time-to-event data under time-varying treatments is important in fields such as medicine (e.g., to decide which sequence of treatments is better in terms of survival probability). However, this task is challenging because treatment decisions, patient characteristics, and censoring probability often evolve together, requiring sequential adjustment for both treatments and censoring. Existing survival learners mostly consider a single baseline treatment assignment, while longitudinal treatment-effect learners typically assume uncensored outcomes. In this paper, we introduce a novel doubly robust learner for heterogeneous survival treatment effects under time-varying treatments and history-dependent censoring. Our framework separates the intervention window from the survival horizon, with treatment prescribed for a finite period, after which care follows its natural course. We further establish the favorable theoretical properties of Neyman-orthogonality, rate double robustness and quasi-oracle efficiency. The framework accommodates flexible machine learning models for nuisance estimation and treatment-effect regression. We evaluate our learners through several numerical experiments, demonstrating their effectiveness.
arxiv.titleZh: 时变治疗下异质性生存治疗效应的双稳健学习
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对时变治疗与历史依赖删失下异质性生存治疗效应难以估计的问题，提出将干预窗口与生存期分离的双稳健学习框架：治疗仅在有限时段施加，之后按自然病程发展，并对治疗与删失进行序贯调整。方法允许使用灵活的机器学习模型估计倾向、删失与结果等 nuisance 函数，并证明 Neyman 正交性、速率双稳健性与准 oracle 效率。数值实验显示该学习器有效，适用于需要比较不同治疗序列生存获益的医学场景。
arxiv.reason: 因果生存分析方法，与LLM及后训练方向无关

arxiv.title: GeoSplit: Selective Edge--Server Map Acquisition for Cross-User Travel-Mode Recognition
arxiv.abstract: Networked mobility sensing couples local trajectory inference with remote geospatial context, making communication decisions part of the prediction system. We present GeoSplit, an edge--server framework for travel-mode recognition that separates the utility of map evidence, its training-time transfer, and its selective acquisition at runtime. On GeoLife with 10% labels, we evaluate these components under user-day and user-disjoint grouping. For unseen users, aligned full-map context raises macro-F1 from 0.7154 to 0.7864, while map-informed distillation yields a motion-only student at 0.7225. Through a compact query interface, entropy gating achieves 0.7729 macro-F1 versus 0.7738 for all queries, querying 39.5% of trajectories and reducing application payload by 60.5%. Under user-day grouping, selective and all-query scores are similarly close at a 21.6% query rate. Learned value estimation and probability fusion offer no consistent improvement. These results illustrate communication-efficient edge--server inference for an intelligent transportation sensing task.
arxiv.titleZh: GeoSplit：面向跨用户出行方式识别的选择性边缘—服务器地图获取
arxiv.summaryZh: 跨用户出行方式识别中，把地图上下文拆成三部分：证据效用、训练期迁移和运行时按需获取；在GeoLife的10%标注设定下，按user-day与user-disjoint两种分组评测。对未见用户，对齐的全地图上下文把macro-F1从0.7154提升到0.7864；地图信息蒸馏得到仅用运动信号的student模型，达到0.7225。运行时经紧凑查询接口与熵门控，macro-F1为0.7729（全查询为0.7738），只查询39.5%的轨迹，应用层载荷减少60.5%；user-day分组下，选择性与全查询在21.6%查询率时接近。学习式价值估计与概率融合没有稳定收益，该框架展示了面向交通感知任务的通信高效边缘—服务器推理路径。
arxiv.reason: 交通出行方式识别，属垂直行业应用且与LLM无关

arxiv.title: Towards Robust Model Organisms for Eliciting Latent Knowledge
arxiv.abstract: A key problem in AI safety is eliciting latent knowledge (ELK), extracting information from a model that is misaligned and more knowledgeable than its overseer. For example, a misaligned model used to scan code for vulnerabilities may want to withhold its findings, i.e., sandbag, in order to exploit them later. To study ELK empirically, we need model organisms that mirror this setting. Existing model organisms fall short in several respects. In this work, we train model organisms to withhold solutions in a vulnerability detection task. We combine transcript distillation with counter-prompting and tamper-resistance training to instill three properties that we argue are critical for a useful ELK testbed: 1) Selectivity, the model sandbags when it thinks the overseer doesn't know the answer and complies otherwise, 2) Robustness, the model resists elicitation, and 3) Retention, the model retains a knowledge advantage over the overseer, as opposed to losing the relevant capability. We train a sequence of model organisms and show that our strongest model substantially outperforms prior models on robustness while keeping the other two properties intact. We hope that our model organisms provide a useful ELK testbed for the community, and that our methodology sparks the development of increasingly challenging model organisms. All our code, models and the dataset are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/lennart-finke/sandbagging.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向引出潜在知识（ELK）的鲁棒模型生物
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对ELK研究缺乏能模拟“模型比监督者更懂却故意隐瞒”的实验载体，在漏洞检测任务中训练会隐瞒答案的模型生物，并用转录蒸馏、反提示与抗篡改训练同时注入选择性、鲁棒性与知识保留三项属性。最强模型在鲁棒性上显著优于既有模型，且未破坏选择性与知识保留，代码、模型与数据集已开源，可作为社区研究sandbagging与ELK的测试平台。
arxiv.reason: ELK与sandbagging对齐研究，方法系统且开源

arxiv.title: Hierarchical Token Merging with Recursive Autoencoders for Unsupervised Grammar Induction
arxiv.abstract: Hierarchical abstraction is a fundamental principle across many data modalities, enabling complex sequences to be represented compositionally at multiple levels. Learning such hierarchies directly from data, without explicit structural supervision, remains a central challenge in representation learning. We investigate whether meaningful hierarchical structure can emerge from compression alone. While autoencoders learn compressed representations through reconstruction, this objective does not necessarily favour meaningful compositional structure. We study this challenge through unsupervised grammar induction, where the underlying hierarchy can be evaluated explicitly. We introduce a hierarchical token-merging autoencoder that recursively combines adjacent tokens into increasingly abstract representations, compressing entire sequences through a variational information bottleneck. The model jointly learns representations and hierarchical structure by marginalising over possible binary trees using dynamic programming. To address training instability, we combine independently trained models through unsupervised consensus and distillation. Experiments on a synthetic, ambiguous grammar demonstrate the emergence of meaningful hierarchical structure without structural supervision. The resulting model achieves 93% grammatical parse-validity and 93% exact reconstruction on held-out sequences, compared with 42% parse-validity for the strongest trivial baseline. These findings establish a proof of concept for hierarchical token merging as a mechanism for unsupervised structure discovery and abstraction learning.
arxiv.titleZh: 面向无监督语法归纳的层次化Token合并与递归自编码器
arxiv.summaryZh: 研究能否仅靠压缩目标让层次化组合结构自发涌现，并以无监督语法归纳作为可显式评估该结构的任务。方法上提出层次化Token合并自编码器：递归地把相邻Token合并为更抽象的表示，用变分信息瓶颈压缩整条序列，并通过动态规划对可能的二叉树做边缘化，从而联合学习表示与层次结构；针对训练不稳定，用独立训练模型的无监督共识与蒸馏加以缓解。在合成歧义语法上，该模型取得93%的句法解析合法率与93%的留出序列精确重建率，而最强的平凡基线解析合法率仅42%。结果说明层次化Token合并可作为无监督结构发现与抽象学习的可行机制。
arxiv.reason: 无监督语法归纳与层次表示，属LLM架构与表示学习擦边

arxiv.title: Parallel Language Models via Variational Decoding
arxiv.abstract: Autoregressive language models emit one token per forward pass. This causes high inference latency, in particular as models are scaled up for quality. In this paper, we introduce Parallel Language Models (PLMs), which generate mutually consistent tokens in one forward pass by routing dependencies through latent auxiliary variables. PLMs are trained using a variational bound that reduces to an autoregressive loss plus a parallel decoding loss. Empirically, PLMs are on a faster and better Pareto frontier than autoregressive and discrete diffusion baselines. Pretrained PLMs achieve near-autoregressive pretraining loss on model scales of 80M to 3B parameters, and speedup follows a power law in model size. When post-trained, our 1.3B model matches or exceeds an identically trained autoregressive model on math, coding, and instruction-following benchmarks, speeding up inference $2.3\text{-}5.7\times$. Together, we show that parallel generation can be trained from a single training objective at autoregressive quality. We will make our code available at https://github.com/mandt-lab/plm.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过变分解码的并行语言模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 自回归语言模型每次前向只生成一个 token，推理延迟高。该工作提出并行语言模型(PLM)，通过潜在辅助变量路由 token 间依赖，在单次前向中生成互相一致的多个 token，并以变分下界训练，该下界可分解为自回归损失加并行解码损失。在 80M–3B 参数上，PLM 预训练损失接近自回归，加速比随模型规模呈幂律增长;1.3B 模型经后训练后在数学、代码与指令遵循上持平或超过同配置自回归模型，推理提速 2.3–5.7 倍。
arxiv.reason: 并行解码新范式，训练目标清晰，含 3B 规模与后训练验证

arxiv.title: Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: Mitigating Rubric Hacking through Latent Dimension Recovery and Balancing
arxiv.abstract: Rubric hacking limits both performance and training robustness in rubric-based reinforcement learning. By decomposing rubrics into sub-dimensions, we reveal the Intra-Rubric Reward Divergence: as the total rubric score increases, certain sub-dimension scores systematically decrease, suggesting the model sacrifices specific quality aspects to optimize the aggregated objective. From the sub-dimension perspective, we observe two phenomena: (1) dimension imbalance, causing the policy to favor heavily covered dimensions; (2) dimension absence, leading to a systematic gap between rewards and true quality. To mitigate these issues, we propose Fair-Race Dimension Aggregation (FRDA), which has generations compete within each dimension separately to mitigate rubric imbalance, and Residual Semantic Dimension Completion (RSDC), which mines evaluation dimensions implicitly encoded in a holistic preference signal to complete rubric coverage. Experiments in chat, science, and medical domains indicate that FRDA mitigates rubric hacking with more stable improvements, while RSDC outperforms both single-reward training and naive multi-reward aggregation, yielding generally higher-quality responses.
arxiv.titleZh: 评分细则内部奖励分歧：通过潜在维度恢复与平衡缓解 Rubric Hacking
arxiv.summaryZh: 基于 rubric 的强化学习里，模型会牺牲部分质量维度去刷高聚合总分，即 rubric hacking。把 rubric 拆成子维度后可以看到评分细则内部的奖励分歧，表现为维度失衡（策略偏向被覆盖多的维度）与维度缺失（奖励与真实质量系统性偏离）。为此提出 FRDA，让同一 prompt 的各次生成在每个子维度内单独竞争，抵消维度失衡；以及 RSDC，从整体偏好信号中挖掘隐含的评价维度以补全 rubric 覆盖。在对话、科学、医疗三个域的实验中，FRDA 缓解了 rubric hacking 且提升更稳定，RSDC 优于单奖励训练与朴素多奖励聚合，响应质量整体更高。
arxiv.reason: rubric 奖励的 RL 后训练工作，直击奖励设计与 hacking 问题

arxiv.title: StepBench: Diagnosing Real-World Procedural Understanding in AI Agents
arxiv.abstract: Evaluating an agent's planning ability remains challenging for open-domain tasks, where verifying procedures through execution is often impractical. Existing evaluations typically assess only the final plan and do not distinguish procedural errors such as missing, incorrect, or misordered actions. We introduce STEPBENCH, a benchmark of 6,885 verified procedures crawled from wikiHow across 81 open-domain categories. From each procedure, we derive 5 diagnostic tasks: four with deterministic answers involving withheld, incorrect, or shuffled steps, and one requiring next-step generation. We additionally evaluate full-plan generation to examine how diagnostic performance correlates with end-to-end plan validity. Using the same procedures across tasks lets us directly compare different planning capabilities. For generation, STEPEVAL identifies critical failures that prevent goal completion. Across 14 configurations of 12 models, we find substantial differences across planning capabilities, with step ordering proving the most difficult: the strongest model correctly orders only 63.0% of procedures, dropping to 33.1% for those with nine or more steps. Incorrect-step detection also predicts judged plan validity across models, suggesting a lower-cost alternative for evaluating generation quality. On STEPBENCH-Val, comprising 214 procedures published in 2026, comprehension scores and rankings remain stable, suggesting limited influence from memorisation.
arxiv.titleZh: StepBench：诊断 AI Agent 的真实世界流程理解能力
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对开放域任务中 Agent 规划难以通过执行验证的问题，构建含 6,885 条 wikiHow 已验证流程、覆盖 81 个类别的基准，从每条流程派生 5 个诊断任务：4 个确定性任务（步骤缺失、步骤错误、步骤乱序）与 1 个下一步生成，另设完整计划生成以检验诊断表现与端到端计划有效性的相关性。同一流程跨任务复用，可直接比较不同规划能力。实测 12 个模型、14 种配置，步骤排序最难：最强模型仅正确排序 63.0% 的流程，九步及以上降至 33.1%；错误步骤检测可预测计划有效性评分，是更低成本的生成质量评估替代。在 214 条 2026 年新流程的验证集上分数与排名稳定，记忆影响有限。
arxiv.reason: Agent 规划诊断基准，命中 Agent 与评测方法学方向

arxiv.title: Which Model for Which Role? Cost-Efficient Pareto Recommendation for LLM Agentic Workflows
arxiv.abstract: LLM agentic workflows increasingly employ different models for specialized roles. Users may prefer different trade-offs between task quality and deployment cost, sometimes also considering latency. Finding good assignments incurs a separate search cost from evaluating multiple candidates. We introduce Cost-Coupled Gittins (CC-Gittins), a multi-objective extension of single-objective cost-aware Gittins search for Pareto recommendation. It exploits the coupling between evaluation and deployment costs: assignments that cost more to deploy also cost more to evaluate. The search alternates between seeking higher quality and lower deployment cost, reusing each evaluation to inform both searches. After each batch, CC-Gittins recommends assignments that are nondominated under uncertainty-adjusted estimates of quality and deployment cost. We evaluate CC-Gittins on eight quality--cost matrices from workflows with two to five roles and up to 1,681 candidate assignments. We also evaluate the method with latency as a third objective. Across the eight benchmarks, CC-Gittins recovers a substantial fraction of the true Pareto frontier at roughly 10% of the exhaustive-evaluation cost, and recovers most of the frontier with few false positives by 30%.
arxiv.comment: Preliminary version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Resource-Aware Agentic AI (RAAAI)
arxiv.titleZh: 哪个模型担任何种角色？面向 LLM Agentic 工作流的高性价比 Pareto 推荐
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对按角色为 LLM agentic 工作流分配模型时，要在质量与部署成本之间权衡，而搜索候选分配本身代价高昂的问题，提出 CC-Gittins，把单目标 cost-aware Gittins 搜索扩展为多目标 Pareto 推荐：利用部署成本越高、评估成本也越高的耦合关系，交替搜索更高质量与更低部署成本，并复用同一次评估同时支撑两条搜索，每批评估后按不确定性调整后的质量与成本估计输出非支配分配。在 8 个含 2 至 5 个角色、最多 1,681 个候选分配的质量-成本矩阵上，约 10% 的穷举评估成本即可恢复相当大部分真实 Pareto 前沿，30% 成本可恢复大部分前沿且误报较少，并可将延迟作为第三目标。
arxiv.reason: Agent 工作流的模型分配与成本优化，选题扎实但为 workshop 初步工作

arxiv.title: PACT: Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-Graphs for Dynamic Multi-Agent Combinatorial Optimization
arxiv.abstract: Multi-agent approaches have been investigated recently as a means of improving the scalability of reinforcement learning for neural combinatorial optimization. Existing methods assume that all problem instance information is known upfront. However, real-world problems are often dynamic: relevant information is progressively revealed as the agents take actions (e.g., arriving at an edge in a routing problem only to discover it is untraversable). In such cases, existing methods fail to coordinate agents to explore and exploit the progressively revealed information. To address the arising coordination challenge, we introduce PACT (Plan-Augmented Coordination via Trace-graphs). PACT augments the environment graph with auxiliary nodes representing the plans of agents, which are connected to the resource nodes to indicate future dependencies. The proposed message-passing scheme over the augmented graph grounds inter-agent coordination in the environment and enables proactive, rather than reactive, conflict resolution. We show that PACT improves solution quality in dynamic problems relative to baselines and exhibits the best transfer to larger instances on which, remarkably, it outperforms centralized oracles with privileged access to instance uncertainty.
arxiv.titleZh: PACT：通过轨迹图实现计划增强的多智能体协调，用于动态组合优化
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对神经组合优化的多智能体 RL 方法普遍假设实例信息完全已知，而真实问题常随智能体动作逐步揭示信息(如走到边上才发现不可通行)的问题，提出 PACT:在环境图上增设计划节点表示各智能体的规划，并与资源节点相连以表达未来依赖，通过增广图上的消息传递把智能体间的协调建立在环境结构上，实现主动而非被动的冲突消解。在动态问题上 PACT 解质量优于基线，向更大实例的迁移表现最好，甚至超过可访问实例不确定性的中心化 oracle。
arxiv.reason: 多智能体 RL 组合优化，与 LLM 后训练/Agent 主线无直接交集

arxiv.title: Nested Shared-Operator Recursion on ARC-AGI-1: An Empirical Study of HRM, TRM and URM
arxiv.abstract: Recursive reasoning models refine persistent internal states by repeatedly applying learned operators. We investigate whether adding a persistent intermediate state that integrates repeated updates of a faster state through the same operator improves predictive performance relative to each model family's baseline at matched parameter counts. We define this organisation operationally and implement it within three architectures: the Hierarchical Reasoning Model (HRM), Tiny Recursive Model (TRM) and Universal Reasoning Model (URM). Using the official codebases on ARC-AGI-1, we compare each baseline with its parameter-matched nested variant. We evaluate held-out queries from tasks whose demonstrations were available during training. The experiments use a single-GPU budget far below the published training protocols. Under the tested conditions, nested variants show no consistent advantage in token accuracy, predictive loss or exact solving, which remains near zero for all configurations. The results therefore leave the hypothesis open. We specify a confirmatory comparison, with an informative baseline, multiple seeds, controls that isolate nesting and predefined criteria, to determine whether this organisation merits further development.
arxiv.titleZh: 在 ARC-AGI-1 上研究嵌套共享算子递归：HRM、TRM 与 URM 的实证研究
arxiv.summaryZh: 递归推理模型通过反复施加同一学习到的算子来精化持久内部状态；该文考察在此基础上再引入一个持久中间状态是否有增益：这个中间状态整合的是同一算子对更快状态的多次更新。研究在 HRM、TRM、URM 三个架构中实现该组织方式，用官方代码库在 ARC-AGI-1 上与参数匹配的基线对比，评测训练中见过演示的任务的留出查询。在远低于原论文训练配置的单 GPU 预算下，嵌套变体在 token 准确率、预测损失与精确求解率上均无一致优势，精确求解率在所有配置下都接近零。结论是假设仍未被否定，并给出一套确认性实验方案：信息量更高的基线、多种子、隔离嵌套因素的对照与预设判据。
arxiv.reason: 递归推理架构与 ARC 推理评测擦边，但实验规模小、结果为负且不确定
